Volume 5 Annals 5: Emperor Wen

Chapter 5 of 宋書 ✓ Translated

1
景平二年七月中，少帝廢。 百官備法駕奉迎，入奉皇統。 行臺至江陵，進璽紱。 侍中臣琇、散騎常侍臣嶷之、中書監尚書令護軍將軍建城縣公臣亮、左衞將軍臣景仁、給事中游擊將軍龍鄉縣侯臣隆、越騎校尉都亭侯臣綱、給事黃門侍郎臣孔璩之、散騎侍郎臣劉思考、員外散騎侍郎臣潘盛、中書侍郎臣何尚之、羽林監封陽縣開國侯臣蕭思話、長兼尚書左丞德陽縣侯臣孫康、吏部郎中騎都尉臣張茂度、儀曹郎中臣徐長琳、倉部郎中臣庾俊之、都官郎中臣袁洵等上表曰：「臣聞否泰相革，數窮則變，天道所以不謟，卜世所以靈長。 乃者運距陵夷，王室艱晦，九服之命，靡所適歸，高祖之業，將墜于地。 賴基厚德深，人神同奬，社稷以寧，有生獲乂。 伏惟陛下君德自然，聖明在御，孝悌著於家邦，風猷宣於蕃牧。 是以徵祥雜沓，符瑞㸌煇。 宗廟神靈，乃眷西顧，萬邦黎獻，望景託生。 臣等忝荷朝列，豫充將命，復集休明之運，再覩太平之業。 行臺至止，瞻望城闕，不勝喜說鳧藻之情，謹詣門拜表以聞。 」上答曰：「皇運艱弊，數鍾屯夷，仰惟崇基，感尋國故，永慕厥躬，悲慨交集。 賴七百祚永，股肱忠賢，故能休否以泰，天人式序。 猥以不德，謬降大命，顧己兢悸，何以克堪。 輒當暫歸朝庭，展哀陵寢，并與賢彥申寫所懷。 望體其心，勿為辭費。 」府州佐史並稱臣，請題牓諸門，一依宮省，上不許。 甲戌，發江陵。 八月丙申，車駕至京城。 [1]丁酉，謁初寧陵，還於中堂即皇帝位。
In the middle of the seventh month of Jingping 2 (424), the Young Emperor was deposed. The officials prepared the imperial carriage and escort to welcome him and install him in the imperial succession. When the mobile secretariat reached Jiangling, they presented the imperial seal and cord. Palace Attendant Chen Qiu, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Chen Yan-zhi, Supervisor of the Secretariat and Director of the Imperial Secretariat Chen Liang, Defender-General of the Household and Duke of Jiancheng, General of the Left Guard Chen Jingren, Attendant-in-Ordinary and General of Roaming Attack Chen Long, Marquis of Longxiang, Colonel of Agile Cavalry and Marquis of Duting Chen Gang, Attendant of the Yellow Gate Kong Qun-zhi, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Liu Sikao, Supernumerary Regular Attendant Pan Sheng, Secretariat Attendant He Shang-zhi, Supervisor of the Forest of Feathers and Opening Marquis of Fengyang Xiao Sihua, Concurrent Left Director of the Imperial Secretariat and Marquis of Deyang Sun Kang, Director of the Ministry of Personnel Zhang Maodu, Director of the Bureau of Rites Xu Changlin, Director of the Bureau of Granaries Yu Jun-zhi, Director of the Bureau of Justice Yuan Xun, and others submitted a memorial: "We have heard that decline and prosperity take turns, and that when fate’s number is spent change must come—this is why Heaven’s Way does not keep silent and why a dynasty’s allotted span may yet prove enduring." Of late the cycle had turned toward decline: the royal house fell into hardship, commands from the nine domains had nowhere to go, and the Founding Ancestor’s enterprise was about to crash to earth. We relied on your deep virtue and firm foundation; men and spirits alike lent their aid, so the altars were secured and the people were brought to peace. We humbly consider that Your Majesty’s sovereign virtue is innate, your sagely clarity holds the throne, filial piety and brotherly duty shine at home and abroad, and your moral influence is proclaimed in the frontier provinces. Therefore auspicious signs have crowded in and portents blazed with splendor. The spirits of the ancestral temples have turned their gaze westward; the myriad states and all peoples look to your radiance and entrust their lives to you. We who unworthily bear office at court were privileged to carry your commission; we gather again in this flourishing age and once more behold the enterprise of great peace. The mobile secretariat has arrived; gazing upon the city towers, we cannot contain our joy—we respectfully come to the gate to submit this memorial for your notice. " The Emperor replied: "The imperial fortune has been hard pressed and fate has struck difficulty and calamity. Looking up to the lofty foundation, I feel and seek the state’s past, ever longing for that person—grief and indignation mingle within me. We relied on the seven hundred years’ enduring mandate and on loyal, worthy ministers at the throne, and thus decline could turn to prosperity and Heaven and men could take their proper order. I am unworthy and have wrongly received the great mandate; looking upon myself I am fearful and trembling—how could I bear it? I shall for the present return to the court, display mourning at the imperial tombs, and together with worthy ministers set forth what is in my heart. I hope you will enter into my feelings and do not make your words elaborate. " The prefectural and district aides all styled themselves ministers and asked to inscribe placards on the gates as at the palace; the Emperor did not permit it. On jiaxu day he set out from Jiangling. On bingshen day of the eighth month the imperial carriage reached the capital. On dingyou day he visited the Chuning Mausoleum, returned to the central hall, and thereupon assumed the imperial throne.
2
元嘉元年秋八月丁酉，大赦天下，改景平二年為元嘉元年。 文武賜位二等，逋租宿債勿復收。 庚子，以行撫軍將軍、荊州刺史謝晦為撫軍將軍、荊州刺史。 癸卯，司空、錄尚書事、揚州刺史徐羨之進位司徒，衞將軍、江州刺史王弘進位司空，中書監、護軍將軍傅亮加左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司，撫軍將軍、荊州刺史謝晦進號衞將軍，鎮北將軍、南兗州刺史檀道濟進號征北將軍。 甲辰，追尊所生胡婕妤為皇太后，諡曰章后。 衞將軍、南徐州刺史彭城王義康進號驃騎將軍，冠軍將軍、南豫州刺史義恭進號撫軍將軍，封江夏王。 立第六皇弟義宣為竟陵王，第七皇弟義季為衡陽王。 戊申，以豫州刺史劉粹為雍州刺史，驍騎將軍管義之為豫州刺史，南蠻校尉到彥之為中領軍。 己酉，減荊、湘二州今年稅布之半。
In the eighth month of Yuanjia 1 (424), on dingyou day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and Jingping 2 was changed to Yuanjia 1. Civil and military officials were granted two ranks of promotion; overdue rents and old debts were not to be collected again. On gengzi day Acting Pacifying-Army General and Inspector of Jing Province Xie Hui was confirmed as Pacifying-Army General and Inspector of Jing Province. On guimao day Xu Xian-zhi, Minister of Works, Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat, and Inspector of Yang Province, was promoted to Grand Minister; Wang Hong, Guards General and Inspector of Jiang Province, was promoted to Minister of Works; Fu Liang, Supervisor of the Secretariat and Defender-General, was given the additional title of Left Grand Master of the Palace with privilege of an office equal to the Three Excellencies; Xie Hui, Pacifying-Army General and Inspector of Jing Province, was advanced to Guards General; and Tan Daoji, Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Southern Yan Province, was advanced to Campaigning-North General. On jiachen day his birth mother, Lady Hu the Talented Lady, was posthumously honored as Empress Dowager with the posthumous title Empress Zhang. Guards General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was advanced to General of Agile Cavalry, and General Who Conquers the Champions and Inspector of Southern Yu Province Yigong was advanced to Pacifying-Army General and enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangxia. The sixth younger imperial brother Yixuan was established as Prince of Jingling, and the seventh younger imperial brother Yiji as Prince of Hengyang. On wushen day Liu Cui, Inspector of Yu Province, was made Inspector of Yong Province; Guan Yizhi, General of Valiant Cavalry, was made Inspector of Yu Province; and Dao Yanzhi, Colonel Director of the Southern Man, was made General of the Central Army. On jiyou day the cloth tax of Jing and Xiang provinces for this year was reduced by half.
3
九月丙子，立妃袁氏為皇后。
On bingzi day of the ninth month Consort Yuan was established as Empress.
4
二年春正月丙寅，司徒徐羨之、尚書令傅亮奉表歸政，上始親覽。 辛未，車駕祠南郊，[2]大赦天下。
In the first month of the second year, on bingyin day, Grand Minister Xu Xian-zhi and Director of the Imperial Secretariat Fu Liang submitted memorials returning government to the Emperor, and the Emperor for the first time personally reviewed affairs. On xinwei day the imperial carriage sacrificed at the southern suburb, and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
5
三月乙丑，左將軍、徐州刺史王仲德進號安北將軍。
On yichou day of the third month Wang Zhongde, General of the Left and Inspector of Xu Province, was advanced to Pacifying-North General.
6
夏五月戊寅，特進謝澹卒。
In the fifth month of summer, on wuyin day, Special Grand Master Xie Dan died.
7
秋八月甲申，以關中流民出漢川，置京兆、扶風、馮翊等郡。 乙酉，驃騎將軍、南徐州刺史彭城王義康為開府儀同三司，新除司空王弘為車騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，以右軍長史江恒為廣州刺史。
In the eighth month of autumn, on jiashen day, because displaced persons from Guanzhong had come out to the Han River, the commanderies of Jingzhao, Fufeng, and Pingyi were established. On yiyou day Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Xu Province, was given privilege of an office equal to the Three Excellencies; the newly appointed Minister of Works Wang Hong was made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry with the same privilege; and Jiang Heng, Chief Clerk of the Right Army, was made Inspector of Guang Province.
8
冬十一月癸酉，以前將軍楊玄為征西將軍、北秦州刺史。
In the eleventh month of winter, on guiyou day, former General Yang Xuan was made Campaigning-West General and Inspector of Northern Qin Province.
9
三年春正月丙寅，司徒、錄尚書事、揚州刺史徐羨之，尚書令、護軍將軍、左光祿大夫傅亮，有罪伏誅。 遣中領軍到彥之、征北將軍檀道濟討荊州刺史謝晦，上親率六師西征。 大赦天下。 丁卯，以車騎大將軍、江州刺史王弘為司徒、錄尚書事、揚州刺史，驃騎將軍、南徐州刺史彭城王義康改為荊州刺史，撫軍將軍、南豫州刺史江夏王義恭改為南徐州刺史。 己巳，以前護軍將軍趙倫之為鎮軍將軍。
In the first month of the third year, on bingyin day, Xu Xian-zhi, Grand Minister, Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat, and Inspector of Yang Province, and Fu Liang, Director of the Imperial Secretariat, Defender-General, and Left Grand Master of the Palace, were found guilty and executed. General of the Central Army Dao Yanzhi and Campaigning-North General Tan Daoji were sent to attack Xie Hui, Inspector of Jing Province; the Emperor personally led the Six Armies on a western campaign. A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm. On dingmao day Wang Hong, Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang Province, was made Grand Minister, Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat, and Inspector of Yang Province; Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Xu Province, was reassigned as Inspector of Jing Province; and Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Pacifying-Army General and Inspector of Southern Yu Province, was reassigned as Inspector of Southern Xu Province. On jisi day former Defender-General Zhao Lunzhi was made General Who Pacifies the Army.
10
閏月丙戌，皇子劭生。
On bingxu day of the intercalary month the imperial son Shao was born.
11
二月乙卯，繫囚見徒，一皆原赦。 戊午，以金紫光祿大夫王敬弘為尚書左僕射，豫章太守鄭鮮之為尚書右僕射。 建安太守潘盛有罪伏誅。 [3]庚申，特進范泰加光祿大夫。 是日，車駕發京師。 戊辰，到彥之、檀道濟大破謝晦於隱磯。 丙子，車駕自蕪湖反斾。 己卯，擒晦於延頭，送京師伏誅。
In the second month, on yimao day, prisoners awaiting trial and convicts in service were all pardoned and released. On wuwu day Wang Jinghong, Grand Master of the Palace with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, was made Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and Zheng Xian-zhi, Administrator of Zhang Commandery, was made Right Vice Director. Pan Sheng, Administrator of Jian’an, was found guilty and executed. On gengshen day Special Grand Master Fan Tai was given the additional title of Grand Master of the Palace. That day the imperial carriage set out from the capital. On wuchen day Dao Yanzhi and Tan Daoji inflicted a great defeat on Xie Hui at Yinji. On bingzi day the imperial carriage turned its banners back from Wuhu. On jimao day Hui was captured at Yantou and sent to the capital, where he was executed.
12
三月辛巳，車駕還宮。
In the third month, on xinsi day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
13
夏五月乙未，以征北將軍、南兗州刺史檀道濟為征南大將軍、江州刺史，中領軍到彥之為南豫州刺史。 戊戌，以後將軍長沙王義欣為南兗州刺史。 乙巳，驃騎大將軍、涼州牧大沮渠蒙遜改為車騎大將軍。 詔曰：「夫哲王宰世，廣達四聰，猶巡嶽省方，採風觀政。 所以情偽必審，幽遐罔滯，王澤無擁，九皐有聞者也。 朕以寡薄，猥纂洪緒。 雖永念治道，志存昧旦，願言傅巖，發想宵寐，而丘園之秀，藏器未臻，物情民隱，尚隔視聽。 乃眷區域，輟寢忘飡。 今氛祲袪蕩，宇內寧晏，旌賢弘化，於是乎始。 可遣大使巡行四方。 其宰守稱職之良，閨蓽一介之善，詳悉列奏，勿或有遺。 若刑獄不卹，政治乖謬，傷民害教者，具以事聞。 其高年、鰥寡、幼孤、六疾不能自存者，可與郡縣優量賑給。 博採輿誦，廣納嘉謀，務盡銜命之旨，俾若朕親覽焉。 」丙午，車駕臨延賢堂聽訟。
In the fifth month of summer, on yiwei day, Tan Daoji, Campaigning-North General and Inspector of Southern Yan Province, was made Campaigning-South Grand General and Inspector of Jiang Province, and Dao Yanzhi, General of the Central Army, was made Inspector of Southern Yu Province. On wuxu day Prince of Changsha Yixin, Rear General, was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province. On yisi day Juqu Mengxun, Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Liang Province, was advanced to Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry. An edict said: "When a sage king governs the age, he broadly extends the four hearings, yet still tours the mountains to inspect the regions and gathers the winds to observe how government is conducted. Thus truth and falsehood are surely examined, the hidden and distant are not blocked, royal favor is not hoarded, and the nine marshes have a voice. I, meager and slight, have presumptuously succeeded to the great enterprise. Though I ever bear governing the Way in mind and keep my purpose from dawn, longing to find a Fu Yue I am stirred even in sleep—yet the worthy in hill and dell remain unreached, and the people’s feelings and hidden grievances still lie beyond my sight and hearing. Turning my gaze upon the realm, I cease sleep and forget my meal. Now the baleful vapors are swept away and the realm within is tranquil; to raise the worthy and spread transformation begins from this. Grand envoys may be dispatched to tour the four quarters. District governors who perform their duties well, and every fine quality in cottage and thicket, are to be set forth in full memorials—let nothing be omitted. Where punishments and prisons lack compassion, or government and teaching are perverse and harm the people—report the matter in full. As for the aged, widowed, orphaned, young, and the six infirmities who cannot support themselves, the commanderies and districts may generously measure out relief and supply them. Broadly gather what is heard from the roads, widely receive good counsel, and exhaust the intent of your commission as though I myself were reviewing it. " On bingwu day the imperial carriage attended to cases at the Hall for Extending Worthies.
14
六月己未，以鎮軍將軍趙倫之為左光祿大夫、領軍將軍。 丙寅，車駕又於延賢堂聽訟。 丙子，又聽訟。 以右衞王華為中護軍。
On jiwei day of the sixth month Zhao Lunzhi, General Who Pacifies the Army, was made Left Grand Master of the Palace and General of the Palace Army. On bingyin day the imperial carriage again attended to cases at the Hall for Extending Worthies. On bingzi day he again attended to cases. Wang Hua, General of the Right Guard, was made General of the Central Guard.
15
冬十一月戊寅，以梁、南秦二州刺史吉翰為益州刺史，驃騎參軍劉道產為梁、南秦二州刺史。 己亥，以南蠻校尉劉遵考為雍州刺史。
In the eleventh month of winter, on wuyin day, Ji Han, Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, was made Inspector of Yi Province, and Liu Daochan, Staff Officer of the General of Agile Cavalry, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces. On jihai day Liu Zunkao, Colonel Director of the Southern Man, was made Inspector of Yong Province.
16
十二月癸丑，以中書侍郎蕭思話為青州刺史。 壬戌，前吳郡太守徐佩之謀反，及黨與皆伏誅。
In the twelfth month, on guichou day, Xiao Sihua, Secretariat Attendant, was made Inspector of Qing Province. On renxu day Xu Peizhi, former Administrator of Wu Commandery, plotted rebellion; he and his accomplices were all executed.
17
四年春正月乙亥朔，曲赦都邑百里內。 辛巳，車駕親祠南郊。
In the first month of the fourth year, on yihai day the new year, a partial amnesty was granted within a hundred li of the capital. On xinsi day the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.
18
二月乙卯，行幸丹徒，謁京陵。
In the second month, on yimao day, he traveled to Dantu and visited the Jing Mausoleum.
19
三月丙子，詔曰：「丹徒桑梓綢繆，大業攸始，踐境永懷，觸感罔極。 昔漢章南巡，加恩元氏，況情義二三，有兼曩日。 思播遺澤，酬慰士民。 其蠲此縣今年租布，五歲刑以下皆悉原遣； 登城三戰及大將家，隨宜隱卹。 」丁亥，車駕還宮。 戊子，尚書右僕射鄭鮮之卒。 壬寅，禁斷夏至日五絲命縷之屬，富陽令諸葛闡之之議也。
On bingzi day of the third month an edict said: "Dantu is bound to us by native soil and the great enterprise began there; treading that ground ever calls forth feeling, and stirred emotion knows no limit. Formerly when Emperor Zhang of Han toured the south he added favor to the Yuan clan—how much more when affection and righteousness are redoubled, as in days past. I think to spread lingering grace and repay and comfort the gentry and people. Let this district’s cloth tax for this year be remitted; all punishments of five years or less are entirely pardoned and released; those who fought three battles on the walls and households of great generals—according to circumstances grant hidden condolence. " On dinghai day the imperial carriage returned to the palace. On wuzi day Zheng Xian-zhi, Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, died. On renyin day the use on the summer solstice of five-colored silk life-cords and the like was forbidden—this was the proposal of Zhuge Kan-zhi, Magistrate of Fuyang.
20
夏四月庚戌，以廷尉王徽之為交州刺史。
In the fourth month of summer, on gengxu day, Wang Huizhi, Director of the Court of Justice, was made Inspector of Jiao Province.
21
五月壬午，中護軍王華卒。 京師疾疫，甲午，遣使存問，給醫藥； 死者若無家屬，賜以棺器。
In the fifth month, on renwu day, Wang Hua, General of the Central Guard, died. An epidemic struck the capital; on jiawu day envoys were sent to inquire after the people and provide medicine; if the dead had no family, coffins and utensils were bestowed.
22
六月癸卯朔，日有蝕之。 庚申，以金紫光祿大夫殷穆為護軍將軍。
On guimao day the first of the sixth month there was a solar eclipse. On gengshen day Yin Mu, Grand Master of the Palace with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, was made Defender-General.
23
五年春正月乙亥，詔曰：「朕恭承洪業，臨饗四海，風化未弘，治道多昧，求之人事，鑒寐惟憂。 加頃陰陽違序，旱疫成患，仰惟災戒，責深在予。 思所以側身剋念，議獄詳刑，上答天譴，下恤民瘼。 羣后百司，其各獻讜言，指陳得失，勿有所諱。 」甲申，車駕臨玄武館閱武。 戊子，京邑大火，遣使巡慰賑賜。
In the first month of the fifth year, on yihai day, an edict said: "I respectfully receive the great enterprise and face the realm; customs are not yet spread abroad, the Way of rule has many obscurities, and seeking it in human affairs, I wake and sleep only in worry. Moreover yin and yang have lately been out of order, drought and plague have become calamities; looking up at the warnings of disaster, the blame lies deep in me. I think how to turn my person and restrain my thoughts, deliberate on prisons and examine punishments, above to answer Heaven’s reproof, below to soothe the people’s affliction. All you ministers and the hundred offices—each offer loyal words, point out gains and losses, and let nothing be concealed. " On jiashen day the imperial carriage attended a military review at the Black Tortoise Hall. On wuzi day a great fire struck the capital; envoys were sent to tour and comfort and grant relief.
24
夏四月己亥，以南蠻校尉蕭摹之為湘州刺史。 戊午，以始興太守徐豁為廣州刺史。
In the fourth month of summer, on jihai day, Xiao Muzhi, Colonel Director of the Southern Man, was made Inspector of Xiang Province. On wuwu day Xu Huo, Administrator of Shixing, was made Inspector of Guang Province.
25
五月己卯，以湘州刺史張邵為雍州刺史。
In the fifth month, on jimao day, Zhang Shao, Inspector of Xiang Province, was made Inspector of Yong Province.
26
六月庚戌，司徒王弘降為衞將軍、開府儀同三司。 京邑大水，乙卯，[4]遣使檢行賑贍。 以江夏內史程道惠為廣州刺史。
In the sixth month, on gengxu day, Grand Minister Wang Hong was reduced to Guards General with privilege of an office equal to the Three Excellencies. A great flood struck the capital; on yimao day [4] envoys were sent to inspect the damage and grant relief. Cheng Daohui, Administrator of Jiangxia, was made Inspector of Guang Province.
27
秋八月壬戌，特進、左光祿大夫范泰卒。
In the eighth month of autumn, on renxu day, Fan Tai, Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of the Palace, died.
28
冬十月甲辰，車駕於延賢堂聽訟。
In the tenth month of winter, on jiachen day, the imperial carriage attended to cases at the Hall for Extending Worthies.
29
閏月癸未，以右軍司馬劉德武為豫州刺史。 辛卯，安陸公相周籍之為寧州刺史。
On guiwei day of the intercalary month, Liu Dewu, Chief Clerk of the Right Army, was made Inspector of Yu Province. On xinmao day Zhou Jizhi, Duke of Anlu, was made Inspector of Ning Province.
30
十二月庚寅，左光祿大夫、領軍將軍趙倫之卒。
In the twelfth month, on gengyin day, Zhao Lunzhi, Left Grand Master of the Palace and General of the Palace Army, died.
31
是歲，天竺國遣使獻方物。
That year the state of Tianzhu (India) sent envoys presenting local products.
32
六年春正月辛丑，車駕親祠南郊。 癸丑，以驃騎將軍、荊州刺史彭城王義康為司徒、錄尚書事，領平北將軍、南徐州刺史。 [5]
In the first month of the sixth year, on xinchou day, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the southern suburb. On guichou day Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Jing Province, was made Grand Minister and Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat while retaining Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province. The received edition inserts commentary marker five at this point in the narrative.
33
三月丁巳，立皇子劭為皇太子。 戊午，大赦天下，賜文武位一等。 辛酉，以左衞將軍殷景仁為中領軍。
On dingsi day of the third month the imperial son Shao was established as Crown Prince. On wuwu day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and civil and military officials were granted one rank of promotion. On xinyou day Yin Jingren, General of the Left Guard, was made General of the Central Army.
34
夏四月癸亥，以尚書左僕射王敬弘為尚書令，丹陽尹臨川王義慶為尚書左僕射，吏部尚書江夷為尚書右僕射。
In the fourth month of summer, on guihai day, Wang Jinghong was made Director of the Imperial Secretariat; Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, Administrator of Danyang, was made Left Vice Director; and Jiang Yi, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was made Right Vice Director.
35
五月壬辰朔，日有蝕之。 癸巳，以新除尚書令王敬弘為特進、左光祿大夫。 甲午，以撫軍司馬劉道濟為益州刺史。 乙卯，於雍州置馮翊郡。
On renchen day the first of the fifth month there was a solar eclipse. On guisi day Wang Jinghong, newly appointed Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was made Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of the Palace. On jiawu day Liu Daoji, Chief Clerk of the Pacifying Army, was made Inspector of Yi Province. On yimao day the commandery of Fengyi was established in Yong Province.
36
七月己酉，以尚書左丞孔默之為廣州刺史。 是月，百濟王遣使獻方物。
On jiyou day of the seventh month Kong Mozhi, Left Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was made Inspector of Guang Province. That month the king of Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
37
九月戊午，於秦州置隴西、宋康二郡。
On wuwu day of the ninth month the commanderies of Longxi and Songkang were established in Qin Province.
38
冬十月壬申，中領軍殷景仁丁艱去職。
On renshen day of the tenth month Yin Jingren, General of the Central Army, left office on account of his parent’s mourning.
39
十一月己丑朔，日有蝕之。
On jichou day the first of the eleventh month there was a solar eclipse.
40
十二月丁亥，河南國、河西王遣使獻方物。 [6]
On dinghai day of the twelfth month the states of Henan and Hexi sent envoys presenting local products. The received edition inserts commentary marker six at this point in the narrative.
41
七年春正月癸巳，以吐谷渾慕容璝為征西將軍、沙州刺史。 是月，倭國王遣使獻方物。
In the first month of the seventh year, on guisi day, Murong Gui of Tuyuhun was made Campaigning-West General and Inspector of Sha Province. That month the king of Wa (Japan) sent envoys presenting local products.
42
三月戊子，遣右將軍到彥之北伐，水軍入河。 甲午，以前征虜司馬尹沖為司州刺史。 [7]甲寅，以前中領軍殷景仁為領軍將軍。
On wuzi day of the third month Dao Yanzhi, General of the Right Army, was sent on a northern campaign and the navy entered the Yellow River. On jiawu day Yin Chong, former Chief Clerk of the Campaigning Barbarians, was made Inspector of Si Province. On jiayin day Yin Jingren, former General of the Central Army, was made General of the Palace Army. [7]
43
夏四月癸未，訶羅單國遣使獻方物。
In the fourth month of summer, on guiwei day, the state of Heluodan sent envoys presenting local products.
44
六月己卯，以冠軍將軍氐楊難當為秦州刺史。
On jimao day of the sixth month Yang Nadu, Di chieftain and General Who Conquers the Champions, was made Inspector of Qin Province.
45
秋七月戊子，索虜碻磝戍棄城走。 丙申，以平北諮議參軍甄法護為梁、南秦二州刺史。 戊戌，索虜滑臺戍棄城走。 甲寅，林邑國、訶羅陁國、師子國遣使獻方物。
In the seventh month of autumn, on wuzi day, the Northern Barbarian garrison at Quepo abandoned the city and fled. On bingshen day Zhen Fahu, Pacifying-North Staff Officer, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces. On wuxu day the Northern Barbarian garrison at Huatai abandoned the city and fled. On jiayin day the states of Linyi, Heluotuo, and Shizi (Ceylon) sent envoys presenting local products.
46
冬十月甲寅，罷南豫州并豫州。 以左將軍竟陵王義宣為徐州刺史。 戊午，立錢署，鑄四銖錢。 戊寅，金墉城為索虜所陷。
In the tenth month of winter, on jiayin day, Southern Yu Province was abolished and merged into Yu Province. Prince of Jingling Yixuan, General of the Left, was made Inspector of Xu Province. On wuwu day a mint was established to cast four-zhu coins. On wuyin day the city of Jinyong was taken by the Northern Barbarians.
47
十一月癸未，虎牢城復為索虜所陷。 壬辰，遣征南大將軍檀道濟北討，右將軍到彥之自滑臺奔退。
On guiwei day of the eleventh month the city of Hulao was again taken by the Northern Barbarians. On renchen day Tan Daoji, Campaigning-South Grand General, was sent on a northern punitive campaign; Dao Yanzhi, General of the Right Army, fled in retreat from Huatai.
48
十二月辛酉，以南兗州刺史長沙王義欣為豫州刺史，司徒司馬吉翰為司州刺史。 乙亥，京邑火，延燒太社北牆。 兗州刺史竺靈秀有罪伏誅。
On xinyou day of the twelfth month Prince of Changsha Yixin, Inspector of Southern Yan Province, was made Inspector of Yu Province, and Ji Han, Chief Clerk of the Grand Minister, was made Inspector of Si Province. On yihai day a fire struck the capital, spreading to burn the north wall of the Grand Temple. Zhu Lingxiu, Inspector of Yan Province, was found guilty and executed.
49
八年春正月庚寅，於交州復立珠崖郡。 癸巳，以左軍將軍申宣為兗州刺史。 丁酉，征南大將軍檀道濟破索虜於東平壽張。 [8]
In the first month of the eighth year, on gengyin day, the commandery of Zhuyai was re-established in Jiao Province. On guisi day Shen Xuan, General of the Left Army, was made Inspector of Yan Province. On dingyou day Tan Daoji, Campaigning-South Grand General, defeated the Northern Barbarians at Shouzhang in Dongping. The received edition inserts commentary marker eight at this point in the narrative.
50
二月乙卯，以平北司馬韋朗為青州刺史。 戊午，以尚書右僕射江夷為湘州刺史。 辛酉，滑臺為索虜所陷。 癸酉，征南大將軍檀道濟引軍還。 丁丑，青州刺史蕭思話棄城走。 以太子右衞率劉遵考為南兗州刺史。
On yimao day of the second month Wei Lang, Chief Clerk of the Pacifying North, was made Inspector of Qing Province. On wuwu day Jiang Yi, Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was made Inspector of Xiang Province. On xinyou day Huatai was taken by the Northern Barbarians. On guiyou day Tan Daoji, Campaigning-South Grand General, led his army back. On dingchou day Xiao Sihua, Inspector of Qing Province, abandoned the city and fled. Liu Zunkao, Leader of the Right Guard of the Crown Prince, was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province.
51
三月甲申，車駕於延賢堂聽訟。 戊申，詔曰：「自頃軍役殷興，國用增廣，資儲不給，百度尚繁。 宜存簡約，以應事實。 內外可通共詳思，務令節儉。」
On jiashen day of the third month the imperial carriage attended to cases at the Hall for Extending Worthies. On wushen day an edict said: "Recently military campaigns have been frequent and state expenses have increased; resources and stores do not suffice and the hundred offices are still burdened. Frugality should be preserved to meet actual needs. Within and without, all may jointly deliberate in detail and strive to make things economical."
52
夏四月甲寅，以衡陽王師阮萬齡為湘州刺史。 乙卯，以後軍參軍徐遵之為兗州刺史。
On jiayin day of the fourth month Master of the Army of Hengyang Wang Shi Wanling was made Inspector of Xiang Province. On yimao day Xu Zunzhi, Rear Army Staff Officer, was made Inspector of Yan Province.
53
六月乙丑，大赦天下。 己卯，割江南及揚州晉陵郡屬南徐州，江北屬兗州。 以徐州刺史竟陵王義宣為南兗州刺史，司徒司馬吉翰為徐州刺史。
On yichou day of the sixth month a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm. On jimao day the region south of the Yangzi and Jinling Commandery of Yang Province were assigned to Southern Xu Province, and the region north of the river was assigned to Yan Province. Prince of Jingling Yixuan, Inspector of Xu Province, was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province, and Ji Han, Chief Clerk of the Grand Minister, was made Inspector of Xu Province.
54
閏月庚子，詔曰：「自頃農桑惰業，遊食者眾，荒萊不闢，督課無聞。 一時水旱，便有罄匱，苟不深存務本，[9]豐給靡因。 郡守賦政方畿，縣宰親民之主，宜思奬訓，導以良規。 咸使肆力，地無遺利，耕蠶樹藝，各盡其力。 若有力田殊眾，歲竟條名列上。 」揚州旱。 乙巳，遣侍御史省獄訟，申調役。 丙午，以左軍諮議參軍劉道產為雍州刺史。
On gengzi day of the intercalary month an edict said: "Recently agriculture and sericulture have grown slack, wanderers and idlers are many, wasteland is not opened, and supervision and exaction go unheard. When flood and drought come in a season there is at once destitution—if we do not deeply preserve the fundamental task, [9] abundance will have no source. The prefects who levy taxes within the borders and the district magistrates who are masters close to the people should think to encourage and instruct, guiding them with good rules. Let all exert their strength so the land has no wasted benefit; in plowing, silkworms, trees, and planting let each exhaust their effort. If any have outstanding fields and exceptional harvests, at year’s end list them in detail and send them up. " Yang Province suffered drought. On yisi day an Attendant Censor inspected prison cases and adjusted corvée levies. On bingwu day Liu Daochan, Pacifying-Army Staff Officer, was made Inspector of Yong Province.
55
秋八月甲辰，臨川王義慶解尚書僕射。 丁未，割豫州秦郡屬南兗州。
On jiachen day of the eighth month of autumn Prince of Linchuan Yiqing resigned as Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat. On dingwei day Qin Commandery of Yu Province was assigned to Southern Yan Province.
56
冬十二月，罷湘州還并荊州。
In the twelfth month of winter Xiang Province was abolished and merged back into Jing Province.
57
九年春三月庚戌，衞將軍王弘進位太保，加中書監。 丁巳，征南大將軍、江州刺史檀道濟進位司空。
In the third month of the ninth year, on gengxu day, Wang Hong, Guards General, was advanced to Grand Preceptor and given the additional post of Supervisor of the Secretariat. On dingsi day Tan Daoji, Campaigning-South Grand General and Inspector of Jiang Province, was advanced to Minister of Works.
58
夏四月乙亥，以護軍將軍殷穆為特進、右光祿大夫，建昌縣公到彥之為護軍將軍。
On yihai day of the fourth month Yin Mu, Defender-General, was made Special Grand Master and Right Grand Master of the Palace, and Dao Yanzhi, Duke of Jianchang, was made Defender-General.
59
五月壬申，中書監、錄尚書事、衞將軍、揚州刺史王弘薨。
On renshen day of the fifth month Wang Hong, Supervisor of the Secretariat, Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat, Guards General, and Inspector of Yang Province, died.
60
六月甲戌，以左軍諮議參軍申宣為青州刺史。 分青州置冀州。 戊寅，司徒、南徐州刺史彭城王義康改領揚州刺史。 己卯，以司徒參軍崔諲為冀州刺史。 壬午，以吐谷渾慕容延為平東將軍，[10]吐谷渾拾虔為平北將軍，吐谷渾輝伐為鎮軍將軍。 [11]癸未，詔曰：「益、梁、交、廣，境域幽遐，治宜物情，或多偏擁。 可更遣大使，巡求民瘼。 」置積射、強弩將軍官。 乙未，以征西將軍、沙州刺史吐谷渾慕容璝為征西大將軍、西秦河二州刺史、隴西王。 北秦州刺史氐楊難當加號征西將軍。 壬寅，以撫軍將軍、荊州刺史江夏王義恭為征北將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史，前將軍臨川王義慶為平西將軍、荊州刺史，南兗州刺史竟陵王義宣為中書監、中軍將軍，征虜將軍衡陽王義季為南徐州刺史。
On jiaxu day of the sixth month Shen Xuan, Pacifying-Army Staff Officer, was made Inspector of Qing Province. Ji Province was established by dividing Qing Province. On wuyin day Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Grand Minister and Inspector of Southern Xu Province, was reassigned as Inspector of Yang Province. On jimao day Cui Yin, Staff Officer of the Grand Minister, was made Inspector of Ji Province. On renwu day Murong Yan of Tuyuhun was made Pacifying-East General, [10] Murong Shiqian was made Pacifying-North General, and Murong Huifa was made General Who Pacifies the Army. [11] On guiwei day an edict said: "Yi, Liang, Jiao, and Guang—their territories are remote and governance should suit local sentiment, yet many are partial and overbearing. Grand envoys may again be dispatched to tour and seek the people’s afflictions." The offices of General of Strong Crossbows and General of Strong Bows were established. On yiwei day Murong Gui of Tuyuhun, Campaigning-West General and Inspector of Sha Province, was made Campaigning-West Grand General, Inspector of Western Qin and He provinces, and King of Longxi. The Di chieftain Yang Nadu, Inspector of Northern Qin Province, was given the additional title of Campaigning-West General. On renyin day Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Pacifying-Army General and Inspector of Jing Province, was made Campaigning-North General with privilege equal to the Three Excellencies and Inspector of Southern Yan Province; Prince of Linchuan Yiqing was made Pacifying-West General and Inspector of Jing Province; Prince of Jingling Yixuan was made Supervisor of the Secretariat and General of the Central Army; and Prince of Hengyang Yiji was made Inspector of Southern Xu Province.
61
秋七月戊辰，以尚書王仲德為鎮北將軍、徐州刺史。 庚午，以領軍將軍殷景仁為尚書僕射，太子詹事劉湛為領軍將軍。 壬申，河南國、河西王遣使獻方物。 [12]
On wuchen day of the seventh month Wang Zhongde, Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was made Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Xu Province. On gengwu day Yin Jingren, General of the Palace Army, was made Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and Liu Zhan, Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince, was made General of the Palace Army. On renshen day the states of Henan and Hexi sent envoys presenting local products. The received edition inserts commentary marker twelve at this point in the narrative.
62
九月，妖賊趙廣寇益州，陷沒郡縣，州府討平之。
In the ninth month the demonic bandit Zhao Guang raided Yi Province, overran commanderies and districts, and the provincial administration suppressed and pacified him.
63
冬十一月壬子，以少府甄法崇為益州刺史。 癸丑，於廣州立宋康郡。
In the eleventh month of winter, on renzi day, Zhen Fachong, Director of the Palace Treasury, was made Inspector of Yi Province. On guichou day the commandery of Songkang was established in Guang Province.
64
十二月甲戌，以右軍參軍李秀之為交州刺史。 庚寅，立第五皇子紹為廬陵王，江夏王義恭子朗為南豐縣王。
In the twelfth month, on jiaxu day, Li Xiuzhi, Staff Officer of the Right Army, was made Inspector of Jiao Province. On gengyin day the fifth imperial son Shao was established as Prince of Luling, and Lang, son of Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, as Prince of Nanfeng County.
65
十年春正月甲寅，竟陵王義宣改封南譙王。 鎮北將軍、徐州刺史王仲德加領兗州刺史，淮南太守段宏為青州刺史。 己未，大赦天下。 孤老、六疾不能自存者，人賜穀五斛。 後將軍、豫州刺史長沙王義欣進號鎮軍將軍。
In the first month of spring of the tenth year, on jiayin day, Prince of Jingling Yixuan was redesignated Prince of Nanqiao. Wang Zhongde, Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Xu Province, was additionally made Inspector of Yan Province; Duan Hong, Administrator of Huainan, was made Inspector of Qing Province. On jiwei day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm. Orphans and the aged living alone and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves each received five hu of grain. Prince of Changsha Yixin, General of the Rear and Inspector of Yu Province, was advanced to General of the Army.
66
夏四月戊戌，青州刺史段宏加冀州刺史。 封陽縣侯蕭思話為梁、南秦二州刺史。
In the fourth month of summer, on wuxu day, Duan Hong, Inspector of Qing Province, was additionally made Inspector of Ji Province. Xiao Sihua, Marquis of Fengyang, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
67
五月，林邑王遣使獻方物。
In the fifth month the king of Linyi (Champa) sent envoys presenting local products.
68
六月乙亥，以前青州刺史韋朗為廣州刺史。 闍婆州訶羅單國遣使獻方物。
In the sixth month, on yihai day, Wei Lang, former Inspector of Qing Province, was made Inspector of Guang Province. The state of Heluodan in Campa sent envoys presenting local products.
69
秋七月戊戌，曲赦益、梁、秦三州。 於益州立宋寧、宋興二郡。
In the seventh month of autumn, on wuxu day, a partial amnesty was granted in Yi, Liang, and Qin provinces. The commanderies of Songning and Songxing were established in Yi Province.
70
八月丁丑，於青州立太原郡。 辛巳，護軍將軍到彥之卒。
In the eighth month, on dingchou day, Taiyuan Commandery was established in Qing Province. On xinsi day Tao Yanzhi, General Who Protects the Army, died.
71
冬十一月，氐楊難當寇漢川。 丁未，梁州刺史甄法護棄城走，難當據有梁州。
In the eleventh month of winter the Di chieftain Yang Nadu raided Hanzhuan. On dingwei day Zhen Fahu, Inspector of Liang Province, abandoned the city and fled, and Nadu took possession of Liang Province.
72
十一年春正月，亡命馬大玄羣黨數百人寇泰山，[13]州郡討平之。
In the first month of spring of the eleventh year the outlaw Ma Daxuan and his band of several hundred men raided Mount Tai; [13] the province and commanderies suppressed and pacified them.
73
二月癸酉，以交阯太守李耽之為交州刺史。
In the second month, on guiyou day, Li Danzhi, Administrator of Jiaozhi, was made Inspector of Jiao Province.
74
夏四月，梁、秦二州刺史蕭思話破氐楊難當，梁州平。
In the fourth month of summer Xiao Sihua, Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, defeated the Di chieftain Yang Nadu, and Liang Province was pacified.
75
五月丁卯，曲赦梁、南秦二州劍閣北。 戊寅，以大沮渠茂虔為征西大將軍、涼州刺史。
In the fifth month, on dingmao day, a partial amnesty was granted in Liang and Southern Qin provinces north of Jian’ge Pass. On wuyin day Juqu Maoqian of Northern Liang was made Campaigning-West Grand General and Inspector of Liang Province.
76
是月，京邑大水。
That month the capital suffered severe flooding.
77
六月丁未，省魏郡。
In the sixth month, on dingwei day, Wei Commandery was abolished.
78
是歲，林邑國、扶南國、訶羅單國遣使獻方物。
That year Linyi, Funan, and Heluodan sent envoys presenting local products.
79
十二年春正月辛酉，大赦天下。 辛未，車駕親祠南郊。 癸酉，封黃龍國主馮弘為燕王。
In the first month of spring of the twelfth year, on xinyou day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm. On xinwei day the Emperor personally sacrificed at the southern suburb. On guiyou day Feng Hong, ruler of the Yellow Dragon state, was enfeoffed as Prince of Yan.
80
夏四月乙酉，[14]尚書僕射殷景仁加中護軍。 丙辰，詔曰：「周宗以寧，實由多士，漢室之隆，亦資得人。 朕寐寤樂賢，為日已久，而則哲難階，明揚莫効。 用令遺才在野，管庫虛朝，永懷前載，慚德深矣。 夫舉爾所知，宣尼之篤訓，貢士任官，先代之成准。 便可宣敕內外，各有薦舉。 當依方銓引，以觀厥用。 」是夜，京都地震。
In the fourth month of summer, on yiyou day, [14] Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was additionally made General of the Central Army. On bingchen day an edict said: "The house of Zhou attained peace through its many officers; the rise of the Han dynasty likewise depended on finding capable men. I have long dreamed and waked with joy in worthy men, yet sage discernment remains hard to reach and bright promotion has borne no fruit. Outstanding talent still wanders beyond office, and the court’s storehouses stand empty; thinking forever on the records of old, I am deeply ashamed of my own virtue. To recommend those you know is Confucius’s earnest teaching; presenting scholars and appointing them to office is the settled standard of former ages. Let an edict now be proclaimed within and without, and let each office make recommendations. They shall be weighed and advanced by their measure, that we may see what use they can serve." That night the capital was struck by an earthquake.
81
六月，丹陽、淮南、吳興、義興大水，京邑乘船。 己酉，以徐豫南兗三州、會稽宣城二郡米數百萬斛賜五郡遭水民。 是月，斷酒。 師子國遣使獻方物。
In the sixth month Danyang, Huainan, Wuxing, and Yixing suffered severe flooding, and in the capital people went about by boat. On jiyou day several million hu of grain from Xu, Yu, and Southern Yan provinces and from Kuaiji and Xuancheng commanderies were distributed to the people of the five flood-stricken commanderies. That month the sale of wine was prohibited. The Lion Country (Sri Lanka) sent envoys presenting local products.
82
秋七月辛酉，[15]闍婆娑達國、扶南國並遣使獻方物。
In the seventh month of autumn, on xinyou day, [15] the states of Campasataka and Funan both sent envoys presenting local products.
83
八月壬申，於益州立南晉壽、南新巴、北巴西三郡。 [16]乙亥，原遭水郡諸逋負。
In the eighth month, on renshen day, the three commanderies of Southern Jinshou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi were established in Yi Province. [16] On yihai day all overdue obligations in the flood-stricken commanderies were remitted.
84
九月，蜀郡賊張尋為寇。
In the ninth month the bandit Zhang Xun of Shu Commandery rose in rebellion.
85
冬十一月，以右軍行參軍苟道覆為交州刺史。
In the eleventh month of winter Qu Daofu, Acting Staff Officer of the Right Army, was made Inspector of Jiao Province.
86
十三年春正月癸丑，上有疾，不朝會。
In the first month of spring of the thirteenth year, on guichou day, the Emperor was ill and did not hold court audience.
87
三月己未，司空、江州刺史檀道濟有罪伏誅。 庚申，大赦天下。 以中軍將軍南譙王義宣為鎮南將軍、江州刺史。
In the third month, on jiwei day, Tan Daoji, Minister of Works and Inspector of Jiang Province, was found guilty and executed. On gengshen day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm. Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, General of the Central Army, was made Pacifying-South General and Inspector of Jiang Province.
88
夏五月戊辰，鎮北將軍、徐兗二州刺史王仲德進號鎮北大將軍。 庚辰，以征北司馬王方俳為兗州刺史。
In the fifth month of summer, on wuchen day, Wang Zhongde, Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces, was advanced to Pacifying-North Grand General. On gengchen day Wang Fangpai, Staff Officer of the Campaigning-North General, was made Inspector of Yan Province.
89
六月，高麗國、武都王遣使獻方物。
In the sixth month Goguryeo and the King of Wudu sent envoys presenting local products.
90
八月庚寅，尚書僕射、中護軍殷景仁改為護軍將軍。
In the eighth month, on gengyin day, Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and General of the Central Army, was redesignated General Who Protects the Army.
91
九月癸丑，立第二皇子濬為始興王，第三皇子駿為武陵王。
In the ninth month, on guichou day, the second imperial son Jun was established as Prince of Shixing, and the third imperial son Jun as Prince of Wuling.
92
十四年春正月辛卯，車駕親祠南郊，大赦天下。 文武賜位一等； 孤老、六疾不能自存者，人賜穀五斛。
In the first month of spring of the fourteenth year, on xinmao day, the Emperor personally sacrificed at the southern suburb and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm. Civil and military officials were promoted one rank; orphans and the aged living alone and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves each received five hu of grain.
93
二月壬子，以步兵校尉劉真道為梁、南秦二州刺史。 [17]
In the second month, on renzi day, Liu Zhendao, Colonel of Footsoldiers, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces. The received edition inserts commentary marker seventeen at this point in the narrative.
94
夏四月丁未，以輔國將軍周籍之為益州刺史。
In the fourth month of summer, on dingwei day, Zhou Jizhi, General Who Assists the State, was made Inspector of Yi Province.
95
秋八月戊午，以尚書金部郎中徐森之為交州刺史。
In the eighth month of autumn, on wuwu day, Xu Senzhi, Gentleman of the Gold Section in the Imperial Secretariat, was made Inspector of Jiao Province.
96
冬十二月辛酉，停賀雪。 河南國、河西王、訶羅單國並遣使獻方物。 [18]
In the twelfth month of winter, on xinyou day, the rite of congratulating on snow was suspended. The states of Henan, the King of Hexi, and Heluodan all sent envoys presenting local products. The received edition inserts commentary marker eighteen at this point in the narrative.
97
十五年春二月丁未，以平東將軍吐谷渾慕容延為鎮西將軍、秦河二州刺史。
In the second month of spring of the fifteenth year, on dingwei day, Murong Yan of Tuyuhun, General Who Pacifies the East, was made Pacifying-West General and Inspector of Qin and He provinces.
98
夏四月甲辰，燕王弘遣使獻方物。 [19]立皇太子妃殷氏，賜王公以下各有差。 己巳，以倭國王珍為安東將軍。
In the fourth month of summer, on jiachen day, Prince of Yan Hong sent envoys presenting local products. [19] The Crown Prince’s consort of the Yin clan was installed, and kings, dukes, and officials below them were each granted gifts according to rank. On jisi day King Zhen of Wa (Japan) was made Pacifying-East General.
99
五月己丑，特進、右光祿大夫殷穆卒。 辛卯，鎮北大將軍、徐州刺史王仲德卒。 壬辰，以右衞將軍劉遵考為徐、兗二州刺史。
On jichou day Yin Mu, Special Grand Master and Right Grand Master of Splendid Virtue, died. On xinmao day Wang Zhongde, Pacifying-North Grand General and Inspector of Xu Province, died. On renchen day Liu Zunkao, General of the Right Guard, was made Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces.
100
秋七月辛未，地震。 甲戌，以陳、南頓二郡太守徐循為寧州刺史。
In the seventh month of autumn, on xinwei day, there was an earthquake. On jiaxu day Xu Xun, Administrator of Chen and Nandun commanderies, was made Inspector of Ning Province.
101
八月辛丑，以左衞將軍趙伯符為徐、兗二州刺史。 甲寅，以始興內史陸徽為廣州刺史。 丁巳，以兗州刺史王方俳為青、冀二州刺史。
In the eighth month, on xinchou day, Zhao Bofu, General of the Left Guard, was made Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces. On jiayin day Lu Hui, Administrator of Shixing, was made Inspector of Guang Province. On dingsi day Wang Fangpai, Inspector of Yan Province, was made Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.
102
是歲，武都王、河南國、高麗國、倭國、扶南國、林邑國並遣使獻方物。
That year the King of Wudu, the state of Henan, Goguryeo, Wa (Japan), Funan, and Linyi all sent envoys presenting local products.
103
十六年春正月戊寅，車駕於北郊閱武。 庚寅，司徒、錄尚書事、揚州刺史彭城王義康進位大將軍，領司徒，餘如故。 征北將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史江夏王義恭進位司空，刺史如故。 特進、左光祿大夫王敬弘開府儀同三司。 癸巳，復分荊州置湘州。
In the first month of spring of the sixteenth year, on wuyin day, the Emperor reviewed troops at the northern suburb. On gengyin day Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Minister over the Masses, Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat, and Inspector of Yang Province, was advanced to Grand General; he remained Minister over the Masses, and his other offices were unchanged. Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Campaigning-North General, Commissioner with Credentials Equal to the Three Dukes, and Inspector of Southern Yan Province, was advanced to Minister of Works; his inspectorship was unchanged. Wang Jinghong, Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of Splendid Virtue, received the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes. On guisi day Jing Province was again divided to establish Xiang Province.
104
二月己亥，以南徐州刺史衡陽王義季為安西將軍、荊州刺史。 丁未，以始興王濬為湘州刺史。 癸亥，割梁州之巴西梓潼南宕渠南漢中、南秦州之南安懷寧凡六郡，[20]屬益州。 分長沙江夏郡立巴陵郡，屬湘州。
In the second month, on jihai day, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, Inspector of Southern Xu Province, was made Pacifying-West General and Inspector of Jing Province. On dingwei day Prince of Shixing Jun was made Inspector of Xiang Province. On guihai day the six commanderies of Baxi, Zitong, Southern Dangqu, and Southern Hanzhong from Liang Province and Nan’an and Huaining from Southern Qin Province were detached [20] and assigned to Yi Province. Baling Commandery was carved out of Changsha and Jiangxia commanderies and placed under Xiang Province.
105
夏四月丁巳，以鎮南將軍、江州刺史南譙王義宣為征北將軍、南徐州刺史。 平西將軍臨川王義慶為衞將軍、江州刺史。
In the fourth month of summer, on dingsi day, Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, Pacifying-South General and Inspector of Jiang Province, was made Campaigning-North General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province. Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, Pacifying-West General, was made General of the Guard and Inspector of Jiang Province.
106
六月己酉，隴西吐谷渾慕容延改封河南王。 癸丑，以吐谷渾拾寅為平西將軍，吐谷渾繁暱為撫軍將軍。
In the sixth month, on jiyou day, Murong Yan of Longxi Tuyuhun was redesignated King of Henan. On guichou day Murong Shibin of Tuyuhun was made Pacifying-West General, and Fan Ni of Tuyuhun was made Pacifying-Army General.
107
秋八月庚子，立第四皇子鑠為南平王。
In the eighth month of autumn, on gengzi day, the fourth imperial son Shuo was established as Prince of Nanping.
108
閏月乙未，鎮軍將軍、豫州刺史長沙王義欣薨。 戊戌，復分豫州之淮南為南豫州。 癸卯，以左衞將軍劉遵考為豫州刺史。 戊申，以湘州刺史始興王濬為南豫州刺史，武陵王駿為湘州刺史。
On yiwei day of the intercalary month Prince of Changsha Yixin, General of the Army and Inspector of Yu Province, died. On wuxu day Huainan was again severed from Yu Province to establish Southern Yu Province. On guimao day Liu Zunkao, General of the Left Guard, was made Inspector of Yu Province. On wushen day Prince of Shixing Jun, Inspector of Xiang Province, was made Inspector of Southern Yu Province, and Prince of Wuling Jun was made Inspector of Xiang Province.
109
冬十二月乙亥，皇太子冠，大赦天下。
In the twelfth month of winter, on yihai day, the Crown Prince underwent the capping ceremony and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
110
是歲，武都王、河南王、林邑國、高麗國並遣使獻方物。
That year the King of Wudu, the King of Henan, Linyi, and Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
111
十七年夏四月戊午朔，日有蝕之。
In the fourth month of summer of the seventeenth year, on wuwu day the new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
112
五月癸巳，領軍將軍劉湛母憂去職。
In the fifth month, on guisi day, Liu Zhan, General of the Army of the Palace Guard, left office to observe mourning for his mother.
113
秋七月壬寅，以征虜諮議參軍杜驥為青州刺史。 壬子，皇后袁氏崩。
In the seventh month of autumn, on renyin day, Du Ji, Staff Officer for Consultation in the Office for Campaigning Against Barbarians, was made Inspector of Qing Province. On renzi day, Empress Yuan died.
114
八月，徐、兗、青、冀四州大水，己未，遣使檢行賑卹。
In the eighth month, Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji provinces suffered great floods; on jiwei day envoys were sent to inspect the damage and grant relief.
115
九月壬子，葬元皇后於長寧陵。
On renzi day of the ninth month, the Founding Empress was buried at Everlasting Peace Mausoleum.
116
冬十月戊午，前丹陽尹劉湛有罪，及同黨伏誅。 大赦天下，文武賜爵一級。 以大將軍、領司徒、錄尚書、揚州刺史彭城王義康為江州刺史，大將軍如故。 以司空、南兗州刺史江夏王義恭為司徒、錄尚書事。 戊寅，衞將軍臨川王義慶以本號為南兗州刺史，尚書僕射、護軍將軍殷景仁為揚州刺史，僕射如故。
In the tenth month of winter, on wuwu day, Liu Zhan, former Director of Danyang, was found guilty and executed together with his clique. A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and civil and military officials were granted one rank of nobility. Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Grand General, concurrent Minister over the Masses, Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat, and Inspector of Yang Province, was made Inspector of Jiang Province while retaining Grand General. Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Minister of Works and Inspector of Southern Yan Province, was made Minister over the Masses and Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat. On wuyin day, Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, Guards General, was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province under his existing title; Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and General Who Protects the Army, was made Inspector of Yang Province while retaining Vice Director.
117
十一月丙戌，以尚書劉義融為領軍將軍，祕書監徐湛之為中護軍。 丁亥，詔曰：「前所給揚、南徐二州百姓田糧種子，兗、兩豫、青、徐諸州比年所寬租穀應督入者，悉除半。 今年有不收處，[21]都原之。 凡諸逋債，優量申減。 又州郡估稅，所在市調，多有煩刻。 山澤之利，猶或禁斷； 役召之品，遂及稚弱。 諸如此比，傷治害民。 自今咸依法令，務盡優允。 如有不便，即依事別言，不得苟趣一時，以乖隱卹之旨。 主者明加宣下，稱朕意焉。 」癸丑，尚書僕射、揚州刺史殷景仁卒。
On bingxu day of the eleventh month, Liu Yirong, Director in the Imperial Secretariat, was made General Who Leads the Army, and Xu Zhanzhi, Supervisor of the Secretariat, was made General Who Protects the Army. On dinghai day, an edict said: "The grain and seed for fields previously granted to the people of Yang and Southern Xu provinces, and the rent grain from Yan, the two Yu provinces, Qing, and Xu that in recent years was reduced and should be collected—all are remitted by half. Where there is no harvest this year, [21] remit the obligation entirely. All overdue debts are to be generously assessed and reduced. Market taxes in provinces and commanderies and local market levies, too, are in many places burdensome and harsh. Profits from mountains and marshes are still sometimes prohibited; categories of corvée summons even reach the young and weak. Matters such as these harm governance and injure the people. From now on all shall follow the laws and statutes and strive for utmost generosity and accommodation. If anything is inconvenient, report it separately on its merits; you must not chase the moment and thereby betray the intent of hidden compassion. Let the responsible offices clearly proclaim this throughout the realm, to voice my intent." On guichou day, Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and Inspector of Yang Province, died.
118
十二月癸亥，以光祿大夫王球為尚書僕射。 [22]戊辰，以南豫州刺史始興王濬為揚州刺史，湘州刺史武陵王駿為南豫州刺史，南平王鑠為湘州刺史。
On guihai day of the twelfth month, Wang Qiu, Special Grand Master, was made Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat. [22] On wuchen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, Inspector of Southern Yu Province, was made Inspector of Yang Province; Prince of Wuling Jun, Inspector of Xiang Province, was made Inspector of Southern Yu Province; and Prince of Nanping Shuo was made Inspector of Xiang Province.
119
是歲，武都王、河南王、百濟國遣使獻方物。
That year the King of Wudu, the King of Henan, and Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
120
十八年春二月乙卯，以豫章太守庾登之為江州刺史。
In the second month of spring of the eighteenth year, on yimao day, Yu Dengzhi, Administrator of Yuzhang, was made Inspector of Jiang Province.
121
夏五月壬午，[23]衞將軍南兗州刺史臨川王義慶、征北將軍南徐州刺史南譙王義宣並開府儀同三司。 癸巳，於交州置宋熙郡。 是月，沔水泛溢。
In the fifth month of summer, on renwu day, [23] Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, Guards General and Inspector of Southern Yan Province, and Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, Campaigning-North General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province, were both given offices equal to the Three Excellencies. On guisi day, Songxi Commandery was established in Jiao Province. That month the Han River overflowed its banks.
122
六月戊辰，遣使巡行賑贍。 辛未，領軍將軍劉義融卒。
On wuchen day of the sixth month, envoys were sent to tour the regions and grant relief. On xinwei day, Liu Yirong, General Who Leads the Army, died.
123
秋七月戊戌，以徐、兗二州刺史趙伯符為領軍將軍。
On xushu day of the seventh month of autumn, Zhao Bofu, Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces, was made General Who Leads the Army.
124
冬十月辛亥，以巴東、建平二郡太守臧質為徐、兗二州刺史。 乙卯，省南徐州之南燕、濮陽、南廣平郡。
In the tenth month of winter, on xinhai day, Zang Zhi, Administrator of Badong and Jianping, was made Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces. On yimao day, the commanderies of Nanyan, Puyang, and Nanguangping in Southern Xu Province were abolished.
125
十一月戊子，尚書僕射王球卒。 [24]己亥，以丹陽尹孟顗為尚書僕射。
On wuzi day of the eleventh month, Wang Qiu, Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, died. [24] On jihai day, Meng Yi, Director of Danyang, was made Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
126
氐楊難當又寇漢川。 十二月癸亥，遣龍驤將軍裴方明與梁、秦二州刺史劉真道討之。 是月，[25]晉寧太守爨松子反叛，寧州刺史徐循討平之。
The Di chieftain Yang Nadu again raided Hanzhong. On guihai day of the twelfth month, Pei Fangming, Dragon Cavalry General, and Liu Zhendao, Inspector of Liang and Qin provinces, were sent to attack him. That month, [25] Cuan Songzi, Administrator of Jinning, rebelled; Xu Xun, Inspector of Ning Province, suppressed and pacified him.
127
是歲，肅特國、高麗國、蘇靡黎國、林邑國並遣使獻方物。
That year the states of Sute, Goguryeo, Sumoli, and Linyi all sent envoys presenting local products.
128
十九年正月乙巳，詔曰：「夫所因者本，聖哲之遠教； 本立化成，斆學之為貴。 故詔以三德，崇以四術，用能納諸義方，致之軌度。 盛王聖世，[26]咸必由之。 永初受命，憲章弘遠，將陶鈞庶品，混一殊風，有詔典司，大啟庠序，而頻遘屯夷，未及修建。 永瞻前猷，思敷鴻烈。 今方隅乂寧，戎夏慕嚮，廣訓冑子，實維時務。 便可式遵成規，闡揚景業。」
In the first month of the nineteenth year, on yisi day, an edict said: "What one relies upon is the root—that is the far-reaching teaching of sages; when the root is established, transformation takes form, and earnest study is what is prized. Therefore the three virtues were proclaimed in edicts and the four arts were exalted, whereby one could receive all into the path of righteousness and bring them to the measure. In ages of flourishing kingship and sage rule, [26] all necessarily pass through this. At the beginning of Yongchu, when We received the Mandate, the statutes were grand and far-reaching; We were to shape the myriad kinds and blend diverse customs into one. Edicts went to the responsible offices to open schools broadly, yet repeatedly We encountered hardships and could not complete the work. Ever gazing at the former plan, We think to spread the great achievement. Now the four quarters are at peace, and barbarians and Chinese alike look to Us in admiration; broadly to instruct the sons of officers is truly the business of the age. Let there at once be patterned observance of the established regulations and the spreading illumination of the splendid enterprise."
129
夏四月甲戌，以久疾愈，始奉礿祠，[27]大赦天下。
In the fourth month of summer, on jiaxu day, as his long illness had healed, he first performed the yue sacrifice, [27] and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
130
五月庚寅，梁秦二州刺史劉真道、龍驤將軍裴方明破氐楊難當，仇池平。
In the fifth month, on gengyin day, Liu Zhendao, Inspector of Liang and Qin provinces, and Pei Fangming, Dragon Cavalry General, defeated the Di chieftain Yang Nadu, and Chouchi was pacified.
131
閏月，京邑雨水； 丁巳，遣使巡行賑卹。
In the intercalary month, rain fell in the capital; on dingsi day, envoys were sent to tour the regions and grant relief.
132
六月壬午，以大沮渠無諱為征西大將軍、涼州刺史。
On renwu day of the sixth month, Juqu Wuhui was made Campaigning-West Grand General and Inspector of Liang Province.
133
秋七月，以梁、秦二州刺史劉真道為雍州刺史，龍驤將軍裴方明為梁、南秦二州刺史。 甲戌晦，日有蝕之。
In the seventh month of autumn, Liu Zhendao, Inspector of Liang and Qin provinces, was made Inspector of Yong Province; Pei Fangming, Dragon Cavalry General, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces. At the end of jiaxu day there was a solar eclipse.
134
冬十月甲申，芮芮國遣使獻方物。 己亥，以晉寧太守周萬歲為寧州刺史。
On jiashen day of the tenth month of winter, Rouran sent envoys presenting local products. On jihai day, Zhou Wansui, Administrator of Jinning, was made Inspector of Ning Province.
135
十二月丙申，詔曰：「冑子始集，學業方興。 自微言泯絕，逝將千祀，感事思人，意有慨然。 奉聖之胤，可速議繼襲。 於先廟地，特為營造，依舊給祠置令，四時饗祀。 闕里往經寇亂，黌校殘毀，并下魯郡修復學舍，採召生徒。 昔之賢哲及一介之善，猶或衞其丘壟，禁其芻牧，況尼父德表生民，功被百代，而墳塋荒蕪，荊棘弗翦。 可蠲墓側數戶，以掌洒掃。 」魯郡上民孔景等五戶居近孔子墓側，蠲其課役，供給洒掃，并種松栢六百株。
On bingshen day, an edict said: "The sons of officers are beginning to assemble and studies are rising. Since subtle teachings were extinguished, nearly a thousand years have passed; moved by the matter, We think of those men and Our feelings are stirred with emotion. The descendant of the Sage of Manifestation may quickly deliberate his succession. On ground by the former temple build specially; according to the old practice grant sacrificers and set directors, with offerings in the four seasons. The Que village quarter in the past suffered bandit turmoil and the school halls were ruined; also order Lu Commandery to repair the school buildings and gather students. Sages of old and a single act of goodness—even they would guard their hillock-graves and forbid grazing and fuel-gathering; how much more the Teacher, whose virtue is the measure for living men and whose merit covers a hundred generations—yet his grave yard lies waste and brambles are not cut. Let several households beside the tomb be exempted to attend to sweeping and sprinkling. The leading households of Lu Commandery, Kong Jing and five others living near Confucius's tomb, were exempted from tax and corvée and supplied for sweeping, and also planted six hundred pine and cypress trees.
136
是歲，婆皇國遣使獻方物。
That year the state of Bohuang sent envoys presenting local products.
137
二十年春正月，於臺城東西開萬春、千秋二門。
In the first month of spring of the twentieth year, at the east and west of the palace city the Everlasting Spring and Thousand Autumns gates were opened.
138
二月甲戌，江州刺史庾登之為中護軍。 庚申，[28]以廬陵王紹為江州刺史。 仇池為索虜所沒。 甲申，車駕於白下閱武。
On jiaxu day of the second month, Yu Dengzhi, Inspector of Jiang Province, was made General Who Protects the Army. [28] On gengshen day, Prince of Luling Shao was made Inspector of Jiang Province. Chouchi was lost to the Suolu. On jiashen day the imperial carriage reviewed troops at Baixia.
139
三月辛亥，安西將軍、荊州刺史衡陽王義季進號征西大將軍。 以巴西、梓潼二郡太守申坦為梁、南秦二州刺史。
On xinhai day of the third month, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, Pacifying-West General and Inspector of Jing Province, was advanced to Campaigning-West Grand General. Shen Tan, Administrator of Bazhou and Zitong, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
140
夏四月甲午，立第六皇子誕為廣陵王。
In the fourth month of summer, on jiawu day, the sixth imperial son Dan was established as Prince of Guangling.
141
五月癸丑，中護軍庾登之卒。
On guichou day of the fifth month, Yu Dengzhi, General Who Protects the Army, died.
142
秋七月癸丑，以楊文德為征西將軍、北秦州刺史，封武都王。 辛酉，以南蠻校尉蕭思話為雍州刺史。 甲子，前雍州刺史劉真道、梁南秦二州刺史裴方明有罪，下獄死。
On guichou day of the seventh month, Yang Wende was made Campaigning-West General and Inspector of Northern Qin Province and enfeoffed as King of Wudu. On xinyou day, Xiao Sihua, Southern Man Commandant, was made Inspector of Yong Province. On jiazi day, Liu Zhendao, former Inspector of Yong Province, and Pei Fangming, Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, were found guilty, imprisoned, and executed.
143
八月癸未，以廷尉陶愍祖為廣州刺史。
On guiwei day of the eighth month, Tao Minzu, Director of the Court of Justice, was made Inspector of Guang Province.
144
冬十二月庚午，以始興內史檀和之為交州刺史。 壬午，詔曰：「國以民為本，民以食為天。 故一夫輟稼，饑者必及。 倉廩既實，禮節以興。 自頃在所貧罄，家無宿積。 賦役暫偏，則人懷愁墊； 歲或不稔，而病乏比室。 誠由政德弗孚，以臻斯弊； 抑亦耕桑未廣，地利多遺。 宰守微化導之方，萌庶忘勤分之義。 永言弘濟，明發載懷。 雖制令亟下，終莫懲勸，而坐望滋殖，庸可致乎。 有司其班宣舊條，務盡敦課。 遊食之徒，咸令附業，考覈勤惰，行其誅賞，觀察能殿，嚴加黜陟。 古者躬耕帝籍，敬供粢盛，仰瞻前王，思遵令典。 便可量處千畝，考卜元辰。 朕當親率百辟，致禮郊甸，庶幾誠素，將被斯民。」
On gengwu day of the twelfth month of winter, Tan Hezhi, Administrative Supervisor of Shixing, was made Inspector of Jiao Province. On renwu day, an edict said: "The state takes the people as its root; the people take grain as their heaven. If a single man neglects the harvest, hunger must reach others. When granaries are full, ritual and propriety arise. Recently everywhere is destitute and exhausted, and homes have no stored surplus. When tax and corvée press unevenly, people bear grief and ruin; in years when the harvest fails, illness and want fill house after house. This is truly because governing virtue has not won trust, bringing these ills; yet also because farming and sericulture are not widespread and much of the land's benefit lies unused. The prefects and magistrates are slight in methods of mild transformation, and the people forget the duty of diligent division of labor. Ever speaking of broad relief, at dawn Our thoughts are burdened. Though regulations are issued repeatedly, in the end none are moved to reform—and to sit and hope for increase, how can that be attained? Let the responsible offices proclaim the old articles and strive for utmost earnest instruction. Wanderers and idlers are all ordered to attach to livelihoods; examine diligence and sloth and apply rewards and punishments; observe capacity and on that basis strictly demote or promote. In antiquity the ruler himself plowed the imperial fields and reverently supplied the sacrificial grain; looking up to the former kings, We think to follow the established canon. Let a thousand mu be measured out and the primary day divined. I shall personally lead the hundred officials to perform rites at the suburban fields, that sincerity and simplicity may spread to the people."
145
是歲，河西國、高麗國、百濟國、倭國並遣使獻方物。
That year Hexi, Goguryeo, Baekje, and Wa (Japan) all sent envoys presenting local products.
146
是歲，諸州郡水旱傷稼，民大饑。 遣使開倉賑卹，給賜糧種。
That year provinces and commanderies suffered flood and drought damage to crops, and the people suffered great famine. Envoys were sent to open granaries for relief and grant grain and seed.
147
二十一年春正月己亥，南徐、南豫州、揚州之浙江西，[29]並禁酒。 大赦天下。 諸逋債在十九年以前，一切原除。 去歲失收者，疇量申減。 尤弊之處，遣使就郡縣隨宜賑卹。 凡欲附農，而種糧匱乏者，並加給貸。 營千畝諸統司役人，賜布各有差。 戊午，衞將軍臨川王義慶薨。 辛酉，以太子詹事劉義宗為南兗州刺史。
In the first month of spring of the twenty-first year, on jihai day, Southern Xu, Southern Yu, and west of the Qiantang River in Yang Province—[29] the sale of wine was prohibited throughout. A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm. All overdue debts dating from before the nineteenth year are entirely remitted. Where last year's harvest failed, assess losses and petition for tax reduction. In the worst-afflicted districts, send envoys to the commanderies and counties to grant relief on the spot as circumstances require. All who wish to return to farming but lack seed grain are to receive additional loans of grain. Corvée laborers in the thousand-mu camp and the various overseeing offices are to be granted cloth, each according to rank. On wuwu day, Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, Guards General, died. On xinyou day, Liu Yizong, Supervisor of the Crown Prince's Household, was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province.
148
二月庚午，以領軍將軍趙伯符為豫州刺史。 己丑，司徒、錄尚書事江夏王義恭進位太尉，領司徒。 庚寅，以右衞將軍沈演之為中領軍。 辛卯，立第七皇子宏為建平王。 甲午，以廣陵王誕為南兗州刺史。
In the second month, on gengwu day, Zhao Bofu, General Who Leads the Army, was made Inspector of Yu Province. On jichou day, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Minister over the Masses and Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat, was advanced to Grand Commandant while retaining Minister over the Masses. On gengyin day, Shen Yanzhi, General of the Right Guard, was made General of the Central Army. On xinmao day, the seventh imperial son Hong was established as Prince of Jianping. On jiawu day, Prince of Guangling Dan was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province.
149
夏四月，晉陵延陵民徐耕以米千斛助卹饑民。
In the fourth month of summer, Xu Geng of Yanling in Jinling Commandery contributed a thousand hu of rice to aid famine victims.
150
五月壬戌，以尚書何尚之為中護軍，諮議參軍劉道錫為廣州刺史。
On renxu day of the fifth month, He Shangzhi, Director in the Imperial Secretariat, was made General Who Protects the Army, and Liu Daoxi, Staff Officer for Consultation, was made Inspector of Guang Province.
151
六月，連雨水。 丁亥，詔曰：「霖雨彌日，水潦為患，百姓積儉，易致乏匱。 二縣官長及營署部司，各隨統檢實，給其柴米，必使周悉。」
In the sixth month, rain fell continuously. On dinghai day, an edict said: "For days on end the rains have poured; floods have become a calamity. The people have long lived frugally and easily fall into want. The magistrates of the two capital counties and the supervising offices of the camps and garrisons are each, within their jurisdiction, to inspect and verify cases and supply grain and firewood, and must see to every need."
152
秋七月丁酉，揚州刺史始興王濬加中軍將軍，南豫州刺史武陵王駿加撫軍將軍。 [30]乙巳，詔曰：「比年穀稼傷損，淫亢成災，亦由播殖之宜，尚有未盡。 南徐、兗、豫及揚州浙江西屬郡，自今悉督種麥，以助闕乏。 速運彭城下邳郡見種，委刺史貸給。 徐、豫土多稻田，而民間專務陸作，可符二鎮，履行舊陂，相率修立，并課墾闢，使及來年。 凡諸州郡，皆令盡勤地利，勸導播殖，蠶桑麻紵，各盡其方，不得但奉行公文而已。」
In the seventh month of autumn, on dingyou day, Prince of Shixing Jun, Inspector of Yang Province, was additionally made General of the Central Army, and Prince of Wuling Jun, Inspector of Southern Yu Province, was additionally made General Who Pacifies the Army. [30] An edict said: "In recent years grain crops have been injured and excessive wet and dry extremes have become disasters—this is also because suitable planting has not yet been fully carried out. In Southern Xu, Yan, Yu, and the commanderies west of the Qiantang River in Yang Province, from now on all are to be supervised in planting wheat to help supply what is lacking. Quickly transport available seed from Pengcheng and Xiapi commanderies and entrust it to the inspectors to lend to the people. Xu and Yu have much paddy land, yet the people devote themselves solely to dry-field cultivation; issue orders to the two military districts to restore the old embankments, jointly repair and build them, and also assign reclamation so that it is ready by next year. In all provinces and commanderies, order full use of the land's advantage, encourage planting, and mulberry, hemp, and ramie—each in its proper season—and do not merely carry out documents on paper."
153
八月戊辰，征西大將軍、荊州刺史衡陽王義季為征北大將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史，征北將軍、南徐州刺史南譙王義宣為車騎將軍、荊州刺史。 [31]南兗州刺史廣陵王誕為南徐州刺史。
In the eighth month, on wuchen day, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, Campaigning-West Grand General and Inspector of Jing Province, was made Campaigning-North Grand General, Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Tassel, and Inspector of Southern Yan Province; Prince of Nanqiao Xuan, Campaigning-North General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province, was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jing Province. [31] Prince of Guangling Dan, Inspector of Southern Yan Province, was made Inspector of Southern Xu Province.
154
九月甲辰，以大沮渠安周為征西將軍、涼州刺史，封河西王。
In the ninth month, on jiachen day, Juqu Anzhou of Greater Juqu was made Campaigning-West General and Inspector of Liang Province and enfeoffed as King of Hexi.
155
冬十月己卯，以左軍將軍徐瓊為兗州刺史，大將軍參軍申恬為冀州刺史。
In the tenth month of winter, on jimao day, Xu Qiong, General of the Left Guard, was made Inspector of Yan Province, and Shen Tian, Senior Clerk in the Grand General's Office, was made Inspector of Ji Province.
156
二十二年春正月辛卯朔，改用御史中丞何承天元嘉新曆。 壬辰，撫軍將軍、南豫州刺史武陵王駿改為雍州刺史，湘州刺史南平王鑠為南豫州刺史。
In the first month of spring of the twenty-second year, at the new moon on xinmao day, the Yuanjia New Calendar of He Chengtian, Imperial Censor, was adopted. On renchen day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Southern Yu Province, was reassigned Inspector of Yong Province; Prince of Nanping Shuo, Inspector of Xiang Province, was made Inspector of Southern Yu Province.
157
二月辛巳，以侍中王僧朗為湘州刺史。 甲戌，立第八皇子褘為東海王，第九皇子昶為義陽王。
In the second month, on xinsi day, Wang Senglang, Palace Attendant, was made Inspector of Xiang Province. On jiaxu day, the eighth imperial son Yi was established as Prince of Donghai, and the ninth imperial son Chang as Prince of Yiyang.
158
夏六月辛亥，以南豫州刺史南平王鑠為豫州刺史。
In the sixth month of summer, on xinhai day, Prince of Nanping Shuo, Inspector of Southern Yu Province, was made Inspector of Yu Province.
159
秋七月己未，以尚書僕射孟顗為尚書左僕射，中護軍何尚之為尚書右僕射。 雍州刺史武陵王駿討緣沔蠻，移一萬四千餘口於京師。 乙酉，征北大將軍、南兗州刺史衡陽王義季改為徐州刺史。
In the seventh month of autumn, on jiwei day, Meng Yi, Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was made Left Vice Director, and He Shangzhi, General Who Protects the Army, was made Right Vice Director. Prince of Wuling Jun, Inspector of Yong Province, campaigned against the Man along the Han River and relocated more than fourteen thousand people to the capital. On yiyou day, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, Campaigning-North Grand General and Inspector of Southern Yan Province, was reassigned Inspector of Xu Province.
160
九月己未，[32]開酒禁。
In the ninth month, on jiwei day, [32] the prohibition on wine was lifted.
161
冬十月，起湖熟廢田千頃。
In the tenth month of winter, a thousand qing of abandoned fields at Hushu were brought under cultivation.
162
十二月乙未，太子詹事范曄謀反，及黨與皆伏誅。 丁酉，免大將軍彭城王義康為庶人。 庚戌，以前豫州刺史趙伯符為護軍將軍。
On yiwei day of the twelfth month, Fan Ye, Supervisor of the Crown Prince's Household, plotted rebellion; he and his associates were all executed. On dingyou day, Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Grand General, was stripped of rank and reduced to commoner status. On gengxu day, Zhao Bofu, former Inspector of Yu Province, was made General Who Protects the Army.
163
二十三年春正月丁巳，以長沙內史陸徽為益州刺史。 庚申，尚書左僕射孟顗去職。 遷漢川流民於沔次。 [33]
In the first month of spring of the twenty-third year, on dingsi day, Lu Hui, Administrator of Changsha, was made Inspector of Yi Province. On gengshen day, Meng Yi, Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, left office. Refugees from the Han River region were resettled along the Mian River. The received edition inserts commentary marker thirty-three at this point in the narrative.
164
二月癸卯，以左衞將軍劉義賓為南兗州刺史。
In the second month, on guimao day, Liu Yibin, General of the Left Guard, was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province.
165
三月，索虜寇兗、豫，青、冀刺史申恬破之。
In the third month, the Northern Barbarians raided Yan and Yu provinces; Shen Tian, Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces, defeated them.
166
夏四月丁未，大赦天下。
In the fourth month of summer, on dingwei day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
167
六月癸未朔，日有蝕之。 交州刺史檀和之伐林邑國，剋之。
At the new moon on guiwei day of the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse. Tan Hezhi, Inspector of Jiao Province, attacked the kingdom of Linyi and conquered it.
168
秋七月辛未，以散騎常侍杜坦為青州刺史。
In the seventh month of autumn, on xinwei day, Du Tan, Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry, was made Inspector of Qing Province.
169
八月癸卯，揭陽赭賊攻建安郡，燔燒城府。
In the eighth month, on guimao day, Red-bandit rebels of Jieyang attacked Jian'an Commandery and burned the prefectural seat.
170
九月己卯，車駕幸國子學，策試諸生，答問凡五十九人。
In the ninth month, on jimao day, the Emperor visited the Imperial University, examined the students by question and answer, and fifty-nine passed.
171
冬十月戊子，詔曰：「庠序興立累載，冑子肄業有成。 近親策試，覩濟濟之美，緬想洙、泗，永懷在昔。 諸生答問，多可採覽。 教授之官，並宜沾賚。 」賜帛各有差。
In the tenth month of winter, on wuzi day, an edict said: "The schools have been established for many years, and the sons of the nobility have completed their studies. Having recently witnessed them in the examination in person, We saw their splendid array and, gazing toward Zhu and Si, ever cherish the age of the sages. The students' answers are in many cases worthy of consultation and admiration. The instructing officials are all to receive rewards. " Cloth was granted, each according to rank.
172
十二月丁酉，以龍驤司馬蕭景憲為交州刺史。
On dingyou day of the twelfth month, Xiao Jingxian, Senior Clerk in the Dragon Cavalry Office, was made Inspector of Jiao Province.
173
是歲，大有年。 築北堤，立玄武湖，築景陽山於華林園。
That year there was a great harvest. The northern embankment was built, Black Tortoise Lake was established, and Jingyang Hill was raised in the Hualin Park.
174
二十四年春正月甲戌，大赦天下，文武賜位一等。 繫囚降宥，諸逋負寬減各有差。 孤老、六疾不能自存，人賜穀五斛。 蠲建康、秣陵二縣今年田租之半。
In the first month of spring of the twenty-fourth year, on jiaxu day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and civil and military officials were granted one rank of nobility. Bound prisoners received reduced sentences; all overdue obligations were leniently reduced, each according to circumstance. Orphans, the aged, and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves each received five hu of grain. Half of this year's land tax for Jiankang and Moling counties was remitted.
175
三月壬申，護軍將軍趙伯符遷職。
In the third month, on renshen day, Zhao Bofu, General Who Protects the Army, was transferred to another post.
176
夏五月甲戌，青州刺史杜坦加冀州刺史。
In the fifth month of summer, on jiaxu day, Du Tan, Inspector of Qing Province, was additionally made Inspector of Ji Province.
177
六月，京邑疫癘，丙戌，使郡縣及營署部司，普加履行，給以醫藥。 是月，以貨貴，制大錢一當兩。
In the sixth month, pestilence struck the capital; on bingxu day envoys were sent to the commanderies, counties, and camp and garrison supervising offices to make a general inspection and supply medicine. That month, because goods were dear, large coins were decreed to pass at the value of two standard coins.
178
秋七月乙卯，以林邑所獲金銀寶物，班賚各有差。
In the seventh month of autumn, on yimao day, gold, silver, and precious objects captured from Linyi were distributed as gifts, each according to rank.
179
八月乙未，征北大將軍、徐州刺史衡陽王義季薨。 癸卯，以南兗州刺史劉義賓為徐州刺史。
In the eighth month, on yiwei day, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, Campaigning-North Grand General and Inspector of Xu Province, died. On guimao day, Liu Yibin, Inspector of Southern Yan Province, was made Inspector of Xu Province.
180
九月己未，以中領軍沈演之為領軍將軍。 辛未，以太子詹事徐湛之為南兗州刺史。
In the ninth month, on jiwei day, Shen Yanzhi, General of the Central Army, was made General Who Leads the Army. On xinwei day, Xu Zhanzhi, Supervisor of the Crown Prince's Household, was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province.
181
冬十月壬午，豫章胡誕世反，殺太守桓隆之，前交州刺史檀和之南還至豫章，因討平之。 壬辰，以建平王宏為中護軍。
In the tenth month of winter, on renwu day, Hu Danshi of Yuzhang rebelled and killed Administrator Huan Longzhi; Tan Hezhi, former Inspector of Jiao Province, was returning south and, passing through on his route, suppressed and pacified the rebellion. On renchen day, Prince of Jianping Hong was made General Who Protects the Army.
182
十一月甲寅，立第十皇子渾為汝陰王。
In the eleventh month, on jiayin day, the tenth imperial son Hun was established as Prince of Ruyin.
183
二十五年春正月戊辰，詔曰：「比者冰雪經旬，薪粒貴踊，貧弊之室，多有窘罄。 可檢行京邑二縣及營署，賜以柴米。」
In the first month of spring of the twenty-fifth year, on wuchen day, an edict said: "Recently ice and snow have lasted for ten days; fuel and grain have become dear, and poor and destitute households are in many cases reduced to want. Inspect the two capital counties and the camps and garrisons and grant them grain and firewood."
184
二月庚寅，詔曰：「安不忘虞，經世之所同； 治兵教戰，有國之恒典。 故服訓明恥，然後少長知禁。 頃戎政雖修，而號令未審。 今宣武場始成，便可剋日大習眾軍。 當因校獵，肄武講事。」
In the second month, on gengyin day, an edict said: "In security do not forget peril—this is what governing the age shares in common; training troops and teaching warfare is the constant canon of a state. Therefore, once they are drilled in discipline and know shame, young and old alike understand prohibition. Recently military administration has been cultivated, yet orders and regulations have not been made clear. Now that the Xuanwu training ground is newly completed, on a set day conduct a great drill of all the armies. At the same time hold a hunt review to exercise arms and discuss affairs of war."
185
閏月己酉，大蒐于宣武場。
In the intercalary month, on jiyou day, a great hunt was held at the Xuanwu training ground.
186
三月庚辰，車駕校獵。
In the third month, on gengchen day, the Emperor conducted a hunt review.
187
夏四月乙巳，新作閶闔、廣莫二門，改先廣莫門曰承明，開陽曰津陽。 乙卯，以撫軍將軍、雍州刺史武陵王駿為安北將軍、徐州刺史。 癸亥，以右衞將軍蕭思話為雍州刺史。
In the fourth month of summer, on yisi day, the new Chunhe and Guangmo gates were built; the former Guangmo gate was renamed Chenming, and Kaiyang was renamed Jinyang. On yimao day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yong Province, was made Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Xu Province. On guihai day, Xiao Sihua, General of the Right Guard, was made Inspector of Yong Province.
188
五月己卯，罷大錢當兩。
In the fifth month, on jimao day, the decree that large coins pass at two was abolished.
189
六月庚戌，零陵王司馬元瑜薨。 庚申，安北將軍、徐州刺史武陵王駿加兗州刺史。 丙寅，車騎將軍、荊州刺史南譙王義宣進位司空。
In the sixth month, on gengxu day, Sima Yuanyu, Prince of Lingling, died. On gengshen day, Prince of Wuling Jun, Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Xu Province, was additionally made Inspector of Yan Province. On bingyin day, Prince of Nanqiao Xuan, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jing Province, was advanced to Minister of Works.
190
秋七月壬午，左光祿大夫王敬弘薨。
In the seventh month of autumn, on renwu day, Wang Jinghong, Grand Master of Splendid Virtue of the Left, died.
191
八月己酉，以撫軍參軍劉秀之為梁、南秦二州刺史。 甲子，立第十一皇子彧為淮陽王。
In the eighth month, on jiyou day, Liu Xiuzhi, Staff Officer for the General Who Pacifies the Army, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces. On jiazi day, the eleventh imperial son Yu was established as Prince of Huaiyang.
192
九月辛未，以尚書右僕射何尚之為尚書左僕射，領軍將軍沈演之遷職，吳興太守劉遵考為領軍將軍。
In the ninth month, on xinwei day, He Shangzhi, Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was made Left Vice Director; Shen Yanzhi, General Who Leads the Army, was transferred to another post; and Liu Zunkao, Administrator of Wuxing, was made General Who Leads the Army.
193
二十六年春正月辛巳，車駕親祠南郊。
In the first month of spring of the twenty-sixth year, on xinsi day, the Emperor personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.
194
二月己亥，車駕陸道幸丹徒，謁京陵。
In the second month, on jihai day, the Emperor traveled by land to Dantu and paid respects at the imperial tombs.
195
三月丁巳，[34]詔曰：「朕違北京，二十餘載，雖云密邇，瞻塗莫從。 今因四表無塵，時和歲稔，復獲拜奉舊塋，展罔極之思，饗讌故老，申追遠之懷。 固以義兼於桑梓，情加於過沛，永言慷慨，感慰實深。 宜聿宣仁惠，覃被率土。 其大赦天下。 復丹徒縣僑舊今歲租布之半。 行所經縣，蠲田租之半。 二千石官長並勤勞王務，宜有沾錫。 登城三戰及大將戰亡墜沒之家，老病單弱者，普加贍卹。 遣使巡行百姓，問所疾苦。 孤老、鰥寡、六疾不能自存者，人賜穀五斛。 」遣使祭晉故司空忠肅公何無忌之墓。 乙丑，申南北沛下邳三郡復。 又詔曰：「京口肇祥自古，著符近代，衿帶江山，表裏華甸，經塗四達，利盡淮、海，城邑高明，土風淳壹，苞總形勝，實唯名都。 故能光宅靈心，克昌帝業。 頃年岳牧遷回，軍民徙散，廛里廬宇，不逮往日。 皇基舊鄉，地兼蕃重，宜令殷阜，式崇形望。 可募諸州樂移者數千家，給以田宅，并蠲復。」
In the third month, on dingsi day, [34] an edict said: "We have been away from the northern capital for more than twenty years; though it is said to be close at hand, We have had no path by which to gaze upon the road. Now that the four quarters are at peace, seasons harmonious and harvests abundant, We have again been able to pay respects at the old tombs, display boundless filial devotion, feast old friends, and give voice to Our longing for those gone before. Thus duty to native soil and affection for Pei are joined in one; ever dwelling on it stirs generous feeling—Our sense of comfort and gratitude runs truly deep. It is fitting earnestly to proclaim benevolence and favor and spread them throughout the realm. A general amnesty is proclaimed throughout the realm. Remit half this year's cloth tax for migrant natives in Dantu County. In the counties along the imperial route, remit half the land tax. Prefects and magistrates who have all labored diligently in royal affairs should receive a share of imperial bounty. Households of those killed or lost in the three Wall battles and in great-generals' campaigns, and the old, sick, solitary, or weak—all are to receive relief and support. Send envoys to tour among the people and inquire into their hardships. The orphaned aged, widowers and widows, and those afflicted with the six infirmities who cannot support themselves are each granted five hu of grain. " Envoys were sent to sacrifice at the tomb of He Wuji, former Jin Minister of Works and Loyal and Solemn Duke. On yichou day, tax remissions for the three commanderies Northern Pei, Southern Pei, and Xiapi were announced. Another edict said: "Jingkou from antiquity was where auspiciousness first arose and where recent ages found their signs; girdled by rivers and mountains, within and without the splendid heartland, with roads crossing in all directions and profit reaching the Huai and the sea—its cities lofty and bright, its local ways pure and uniform; gathering every strategic advantage, it is truly a famous capital. Therefore it could illumine the numinous heart and bring flourishing to the imperial enterprise. In recent years provincial governors have shifted back and forth, troops and people scattered and dispersed, and market wards and dwellings no longer match former days. The old homeland of the imperial foundation, its territory doubly eminent and weighty, should be made prosperous and thereby elevate its visible prestige. Recruit from the various provinces several thousand households willing to relocate, grant them fields and houses, and remit their taxes."
196
五月丙寅，詔曰：「吾生於此城。 及盧循肆亂，害流茲境。 先帝以桑梓根本，實同休戚，復以蒙稚，猥同艱難，情義繾綣，夷險兼備，舊物遺蹤，猶存心目。 歲月不居，逝踰三紀，時人故老，與運零落。 眷惟既往，倍深感歎。 可搜訪于時士庶文武今尚存者，具以名聞。 人身已亡而子孫見在，優量賜賚之。 」車駕水路發丹徒，壬午，至京師。 丙戌，婆皇國，壬辰，婆達國，並遣使獻方物。
In the fifth month, on bingyin day, an edict said: "I was born in this city. When Lu Xun wrought chaos, harm flowed through this territory. The late Emperor, because this was native soil, truly shared fortune and woe with it; when I was still young I unworthily shared the hardship—affection and duty closely bound, peace and peril together endured; old things and traces left behind still remain before my eyes. Years do not stay; more than three decades have passed; the people of that time and the old friends have fallen away with fate. Looking back on what is past, Our feeling of sighing is doubly deep. Search out civil and military gentry and commoners of that time who still survive and report all their names.
