Those already dead but whose descendants still live shall receive generous bounty according to merit. " The imperial carriage set out by water from Dantu; on renwu day it reached the capital. On bingxu day the state of Ba Huang, and on renchen day the state of Ba Da, both sent envoys presenting local products.
197
秋七月辛未，以江州刺史廬陵王紹為南徐州刺史，廣陵王誕為雍州刺史。
In the seventh month of autumn, on xinwei day, Prince of Luling Shao, Inspector of Jiang Province, was made Inspector of Southern Xu Province, and Prince of Guangling Dan was made Inspector of Yong Province.
198
八月己酉，以中護軍建平王宏為江州刺史。 癸丑，以南豐王朗為湘州刺史。
On jiyou day of the eighth month, Prince of Jianping Hong, Central Army Guard, was made Inspector of Jiang Province. On guichou day, Prince of Nanfeng Lang was made Inspector of Xiang Province.
199
冬十月，廣陵王誕改封隨郡王。 甲辰，以中軍將軍、揚州刺史始興王濬為征北將軍、開府儀同三司、南徐兗二州刺史，南徐州刺史廬陵王紹為揚州刺史。
In the tenth month of winter, Prince of Guangling Dan was redesignated Prince of Suixiang. On jiachen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, Central Army General and Inspector of Yang Province, was made Campaigning-North General, Secretariat-Director-with-the-Same-Three-Staff, and Inspector of Southern Xu and Yan provinces; Prince of Luling Shao, Inspector of Southern Xu Province, was made Inspector of Yang Province.
200
二十七年春正月辛未，制交、寧二州假板郡縣，俸祿聽依臺除。 辛卯，百濟國遣使獻方物。
In the first month of spring of the twenty-seventh year, on xinwei day, regulations were set for provisional plate-holding commanderies and counties in Jiao and Ning provinces; salaries were to follow metropolitan appointment standards. On xinmao day, Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
201
二月辛丑，右將軍、豫州刺史南平王鑠進號平西將軍。 辛亥，[35]索虜寇汝南諸郡，陳南頓二郡太守鄭琨、汝陽潁川二郡太守郭道隱委守走。 索虜攻懸瓠城，行汝南郡事陳憲拒之。 以軍興減百官俸三分之一。
On xinchou day of the second month, Prince of Nanping Shuo, Right General and Inspector of Yu Province, was advanced to Campaigning-West General. On xinhai day, [35] the Northern Barbarians raided the commanderies of Runan; Zheng Kun, Administrator of Chen and Nandun commanderies, and Guo Daoyin, Administrator of Ruyang and Yingchuan commanderies, abandoned their posts and fled. The Northern Barbarians attacked Xuanhu city; Chen Xian, acting for Runan Commandery, resisted them. Because of military exigency, all officials' salaries were reduced by one third.
202
三月乙丑，淮南太守諸葛闡求減俸祿同內百官，於是州及郡縣丞尉並悉同減。 戊寅，罷國子學。 乙酉，以新除吏部尚書蕭思話為護軍將軍。
On yichou day of the third month, Zhuge Chan, Administrator of Huainan, requested that salaries be reduced like those of metropolitan officials; thereupon officials at the provincial, commandery, and county levels and assistant wardens were all likewise reduced. On wuyin day, the Imperial University was abolished. On yiyou day, Xiao Sihua, newly appointed Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was made Defender-General.
203
夏四月壬子，安北將軍、徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號鎮軍將軍。 [36]
On renzi day of the fourth month of summer, Prince of Wuling Jun, Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced to General Who Settles the Army. The received edition inserts commentary marker thirty-six at this point in the narrative.
204
六月丁酉，侍中蕭斌為青、冀二州刺史。
On dingyou day of the sixth month, Bin, Palace Attendant, was made Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.
205
秋七月庚午，遣寧朔將軍王玄謨北伐。 太尉江夏王義恭出次彭城，總統諸軍。 乙亥，索虜碻磝戍委城走。
On gengwu day of the seventh month of autumn, Wang Xuanmo, Pacifying-Insurgent General, was sent on a northern campaign. Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Grand Commandant, went out and encamped at Pengcheng to command all armies. On yihai day, the Northern Barbarian garrison at Quepo abandoned the city and fled.
206
冬閏月癸亥，玄謨攻滑臺，不克，為虜所敗，退還碻磝。 辛未，雍州刺史隨王誕遣軍攻弘農城，克之。 丙戌，又克關城。
On guihai day of the intercalary winter month, Xuanmo attacked Huatai but did not take it; he was defeated by the barbarians and withdrew to Quepo. On xinwei day, Prince of Suixiang Dan, Inspector of Yong Province, sent troops to attack Hongnong city and took it. On bingxu day, they also took Guan city.
207
十一月戊子，索虜陷鄒山，魯、陽平二郡太守崔邪利沒。 甲午，隨王誕所遣軍又攻陝城，克之。 癸卯，左軍將軍劉康祖於壽陽尉武戍與虜戰敗見殺。 丁未，大赦天下。
On wuzi day of the eleventh month, the Northern Barbarians took Mount Zou; Cui Xieli, Administrator of Lu and Yangping commanderies, was captured. On jiawu day, the army sent by Prince of Suixiang Dan again attacked Shancheng and took it. On guimao day, Liu Kangzu, General of the Left Army, was defeated in battle with the barbarians at the Wu fortress in Shouyang and was killed. On dingwei day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
208
十二月戊午，內外纂嚴。 乙丑，冗從僕射胡崇之、太子積弩將軍臧澄之、建威將軍毛熙祚於盱眙與虜戰敗，並見殺。 庚午，虜偽主率大眾至瓜步。 壬午，內外戒嚴。
On wuwu day of the twelfth month, martial preparations were tightened within and without. On yichou day, Hu Chongzhi, Supernumerary Attendant-in-Ordinary, Zang Chengzhi, Accumulated Crossbows General of the Crown Prince, and Mao Xizuo, Establishing Might General, were defeated in battle with the barbarians at Xuyi and all were killed. On gengwu day, the barbarian pretender led a great host to Guabu. On renwu day, martial law was proclaimed within and without.
209
二十八年春正月丙戌朔，以寇逼不朝會。 丁亥，索虜自瓜步退走。 丁酉，攻圍盱眙城。 是月，寧朔將軍王玄謨自碻磝退還歷下。
At the new moon on bingxu day of the first month of spring in the twenty-eighth year, the court assembly was not held because of the enemy threat. On dinghai day, the Northern Barbarians withdrew from Guabu. On dingyou day, they besieged Xuyi city. That month, Wang Xuanmo, Pacifying-Insurgent General, withdrew from Quepo and returned to Lixia.
210
二月丙辰，索虜自盱眙奔走。 癸酉，詔曰：「玁狁孔熾，難及數州，眷言念之，鑒寐興悼。 凶羯痍挫，迸跡遠奔，彫傷之民，宜時振理。 凡遭寇賊郡縣，令還復居業，封屍掩骼，賑贍饑流。 東作方始，務盡勸課。 貸給之宜，事從優厚。 其流寓江、淮者，並聽即屬，并蠲復稅調。 」甲戌，太尉、領司徒江夏王義恭降為驃騎將軍、開府儀同三司。 辛巳，鎮軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號北中郎將。 壬午，車駕幸瓜步，是日解嚴。
On bingchen day of the second month, the Northern Barbarians fled from Xuyi. On guiyou day, an edict said: "The Xianyun blaze fiercely; disaster reaches several provinces—dwelling on them, I wake and sleep in grief. The brutal Jie have been wounded and shattered, fleeing far in flight; the people cut down and injured should now be restored and put in order. In all commanderies and counties that suffered barbarian raids, order the people to return and resume their livelihoods; bury exposed corpses and cover bare bones; relieve and support the hungry and displaced. Spring labor is just beginning—strive to the utmost in encouraging cultivation. Provisions for loans and grants should in every case be generous. Those who have drifted to the Jiang and Huai regions are all permitted to register where they are and likewise receive remission of tax and corvée levies. " On jiaxu day, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Grand Commandant and concurrent Minister over the Masses, was reduced to Rapid Cavalry General, Secretariat-Director-with-the-Same-Three-Staff. On xinsi day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Settles the Army and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced to North Central Commander. On renwu day, the imperial carriage visited Guabu; that day martial law was lifted.
211
三月乙酉，車駕還宮。 壬辰，征北將軍始興王濬解南兗州。 庚子，以輔國將軍臧質為雍州刺史。 戊申，徐州刺史武陵王駿為南兗州刺史。 甲寅，護軍將軍蕭思話為撫軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史。
On yiyou day of the third month, the imperial carriage returned to the palace. On renchen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, Campaigning-North General, was relieved of Southern Yan Province. On gengzi day, Zang Zhi, Supporting-State General, was made Inspector of Yong Province. On wushen day, Prince of Wuling Jun, Inspector of Xu Province, was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province. On jiayin day, Xiao Sihua, Defender-General, was made Pacifying-Army General and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces.
212
夏四月癸酉，婆達國遣使獻方物。 索虜偽寧南將軍魯爽、中書郎魯秀歸順。 戊寅，以爽為司州刺史。
On guiyou day of the fourth month of summer, the state of Ba Da sent envoys presenting local products. Lu Shuang, the Northern Barbarians' pretender Pacifying-South General, and Lu Xiu, Secretariat Attendant, submitted to allegiance. On wuyin day, Shuang was made Inspector of Si Province.
213
五月乙酉，亡命司馬順則自號齊王，據梁鄒城。 丁巳，婆皇國，戊戌，河南王，並遣使獻方物。 [37]己巳，驃騎將軍江夏王義恭領南兗州刺史。 戊申，以尚書左僕射何尚之為尚書令，太子詹事徐湛之為尚書僕射、護軍將軍。 壬子，以後將軍隨王誕為安南將軍、廣州刺史。
On yiyou day of the fifth month, the outlaw Sima Shunze styled himself King of Qi and seized Liangzou city. On dingsi day the state of Ba Huang, and on wuxu day the King of Henan, both sent envoys presenting local products. [37] On jisi day, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Rapid Cavalry General, concurrently held Southern Yan Province. On wushen day, He Shangzhi, Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was made Director of the Imperial Secretariat; Xu Zhanzhi, Tutor of the Crown Prince, was made Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and Defender-General. On renzi day, Prince of Suixiang Dan, General of the Rear, was made Pacifying-South General and Inspector of Guang Province.
214
六月壬戌，以北中郎將武陵王駿為江州刺史，以振武將軍、秦郡太守劉興祖為青、冀二州刺史。
On renxu day of the sixth month, Prince of Wuling Jun, North Central Commander, was made Inspector of Jiang Province; Liu Xingzu, Quelling-Wu General and Administrator of Qin Commandery, was made Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.
215
秋七月甲辰，安東將軍倭王倭濟進號安東大將軍。
On jiachen day of the seventh month of autumn, Wajin, Prince of Wa and Pacifying-East General, was advanced to Pacifying-East Grand General.
216
八月癸亥，梁鄒平，斬司馬順則。
On guihai day of the eighth month, Liangzou was pacified and Sima Shunze was beheaded.
217
冬十月癸亥，高麗國遣使獻方物。
On guihai day of the tenth month of winter, Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
218
十一月壬寅，曲赦二兗、徐、豫、青、冀六州。 是冬，徙彭城流民於瓜步，淮西流民於姑孰，合萬許家。
On renyin day of the eleventh month, a partial amnesty was granted in the six provinces Southern Yan, Yan, Xu, Yu, Qing, and Ji. That winter, refugees from Pengcheng were relocated to Guabu and Huai West refugees to Gushu, together about ten thousand households.
219
二十九年春正月甲午，詔曰：「經寇六州，居業未立，[38]仍值災澇，饑困荐臻。 可速符諸鎮，優量救卹。 今農事行興，務盡地利。 若須田種，隨宜給之。」
In the first month of spring of the twenty-ninth year, on jiawu day, an edict said: "Having endured raids across six provinces, livelihoods are not yet established; [38] they have again met with flood disasters, and hunger and distress come repeatedly. Quickly dispatch orders to all garrisons and generously assess relief. Now agricultural work is underway—strive to exhaust the land's advantage. If seed for fields is needed, grant it as appropriate."
220
二月庚申，虜帥拓跋燾死。 戊午，[39]立第十二皇子休仁為建安王。
On gengshen day of the second month, the barbarian commander Tuo Ba Tao died. On wuwu day, [39] the twelfth imperial son Xiuren was established as Prince of Jian'an.
221
夏四月戊午，訶羅單國遣使獻方物。 以驃騎參軍張永為冀州刺史。
On wuwu day of the fourth month of summer, Heluodan sent envoys presenting local products. Zhang Yong, Staff Officer in the Rapid Cavalry office, was made Inspector of Ji Province.
222
五月甲午，罷湘州并荊州。 以始興、臨賀、始安三郡屬廣州，丙申，詔曰：「惡稔身滅，戎醜常數，虐虜窮凶，著於自昔。 未勞資斧，已伏天誅，子孫相殘，親黨離貳，關、洛偽帥，並懷內款，河朔遺民，注誠請効。 拯溺蕩穢，今其會也。 可符驃騎、司空二府，各部分所統，東西應接。 歸義建績者，隨勞酬獎。 」是月，京邑雨水。
On jiawu day of the fifth month, Xiang Province was abolished and merged into Jing Province. The three commanderies Shixing, Linhe, and Shi'an were assigned to Guang Province; on bingshen day an edict said: "When wickedness is full the body perishes—barbarian villains meet their allotted reckoning; the cruel barbarian, to the end of his malice, has been notorious from former ages. Without Our armies yet striking, they have already fallen under Heaven's judgment; their sons and grandsons turn on one another, kin and allies divide; the puppet leaders at Tong and Luo all nurse secret submission, and the people left north of the Yellow River set their hearts on Us and beg to serve. To rescue the drowning and cleanse the foul—now is the hour. Let orders go to the Rapid Cavalry and Minister of Works offices, each to take command of its forces and link east and west. Those who come over in good faith and earn merit shall be rewarded in proportion to their service. " That month the capital was deluged with rain.
223
六月己酉，遣部司巡行，賜樵米，給船。 撫軍將軍蕭思話率眾北伐。 以征北從事中郎劉瑀為益州刺史。
On jiyou day of the sixth month, the departmental office was sent on circuit, distributing firewood and grain and providing boats. Xiao Sihua, General Who Pacifies the Army, led his forces north. Liu Yu, Attendant-in-Ordinary on the North Campaigning staff, was appointed Inspector of Yi Province.
224
秋七月壬辰，汝陰王渾改封武昌王，淮陽王彧改封湘東王。 丁酉，省大司農、太子僕、廷尉監官。
On renchen day of the seventh month of autumn, Prince of Ruyin Hun was re-enfeoffed Prince of Wuchang, and Prince of Huaiyang Yu was re-enfeoffed Prince of Xiangdong. On dingyou day, the offices of Grand Minister of Agriculture, Palace Steward, and Supervisor of the Court of Justice were abolished.
225
八月丁卯，蕭思話攻碻磝，不拔，退還。
On dingmao day of the eighth month, Xiao Sihua attacked Qiaoduan, failed to capture it, and withdrew.
226
九月丁亥，以平西將軍吐谷渾拾寅為安西將軍、秦河二州刺史。 己丑，撫軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史蕭思話加冀州刺史，兗州如故。
On dinghai day of the ninth month, Shibin of Tuyuhun, Pacifying-West General, was made Secure-West General and Inspector of Qin and He provinces. On jichou day, Xiao Sihua, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces, was additionally made Inspector of Ji Province while retaining Yan.
227
冬十月癸亥，司州刺史魯爽攻虎牢不拔，退還。
On guihai day of the tenth month of winter, Lu Shuang, Inspector of Si Province, attacked Hulao, failed to capture it, and withdrew.
228
十一月壬寅，揚州刺史廬陵王紹薨。
On renyin day of the eleventh month, Prince of Luling Shao, Inspector of Yang Province, died.
229
十二月辛未，以驃騎將軍、南兗州刺史江夏王義恭為大將軍、南徐州刺史，錄尚書事如故。
On xinwei day of the twelfth month, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Rapid Cavalry General and Inspector of Southern Yan Province, was made Grand General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province, retaining his post as Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat.
230
三十年春正月戊寅，以司空、荊州刺史南譙王義宣為司徒、中軍將軍、揚州刺史。 以南兗州并南徐州。 庚辰，以領軍將軍劉遵考為平西將軍、豫州刺史。 壬午，以征北將軍、南徐州刺史始興王濬為衛將軍、荊州刺史。 戊子，江州刺史武陵王駿統眾軍伐西陽蠻。 癸巳，以豫州刺史南平王鑠為撫軍將軍、領軍將軍。
In the first month of spring of the thirtieth year, on wuyin day, Prince of Nanqiao Xuan, Minister of Works and Inspector of Jing Province, was made Minister over the Masses, General of the Central Army, and Inspector of Yang Province. Southern Yan Province was merged into Southern Xu Province. On gengchen day, Liu Zunkao, General Who Leads the Army, was made Pacifying-West General and Inspector of Yu Province. On renwu day, Prince of Shixing Jun, Campaigning-North General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province, was made Military Guard General and Inspector of Jing Province. On wuzi day, Prince of Wuling Jun, Inspector of Jiang Province, commanded the armies in a campaign against the Xiyang Man. On guisi day, Prince of Nanping Shuo, Inspector of Yu Province, was made General Who Pacifies the Army and General Who Leads the Army.
231
青、徐州饑，二月壬子，遣運部賑卹。
Qing and Xu provinces were stricken with famine; on renzi day of the second month the Transport Office was dispatched to grant relief.
232
甲子，上崩于含章殿。 時年四十七。 諡曰景皇帝，廟曰中宗。 三月癸巳，葬長寧陵。 世祖踐阼，追改諡及廟號。
On jiazi day the Emperor died in the Hall of Containing Elegance. He was forty-seven. His posthumous title was Emperor Jing; his temple name was Zhongzong. On guisi day of the third month he was buried at Changning Mausoleum. When Shizu took the throne, the posthumous title and temple name were altered retroactively.
233
史臣曰：太祖幼年特秀，顧無保傅之嚴，而天授和敏之姿，自禀君人之德。 及正位南面，歷年長久，綱維備舉，條禁明密，罰有恒科，爵無濫品。 故能內清外晏，四海謐如也。 昔漢氏東京常稱建武、永平故事，自茲厥後，亦每以元嘉為言，斯固盛矣。 授將遣帥，乖分閫之命，才謝光武，而遙制兵略，至於攻日戰時，莫不仰聽成旨。 雖覆師喪旅，將非韓、白，而延寇慼境，抑此之由。 及至言漏衾衽，難結商豎，雖禍生非慮，蓋亦有以而然也。 嗚呼哀哉！
The historian writes: Taizu was precociously brilliant; though he never received the stern schooling of guardian and tutor, Heaven had given him a gentle, quick mind, and he bore the virtue of a sovereign by nature. Once enthroned, he reigned many years; every strand of governance was in order, laws and bans lucid and strict, punishments followed fixed statutes, and ennoblement knew no careless rank. Thus the inner court was pure and the outer realm tranquil; all under Heaven lay quiet as if at peace. Formerly Eastern Han writers often cited the models of Jianwu and Yongping; after that age too men spoke of Yuanjia in the same breath—truly it was a golden time. In appointing generals and sending commanders he overrode the proper division of frontier authority; his gifts were no match for Guangwu's, yet he directed strategy from the capital—on the day of battle every commander waited upon the throne's final word. Though campaigns ended in ruin and his commanders were no Han Xin or Bai Qi, that the foe lingered and the frontiers bled—this too stemmed from that habit. When at last whispers escaped the bed curtain and scandal bound him to a petty trader, though disaster came unlooked-for, there were reasons enough. Alas! How pitiable!
234
校勘記
Collation notes
235
車駕至京城孫虨宋書考論云：「當作京邑。 京城則京口矣。 」按通鑑作建康。 宋書京城往往指京口城，此則指建康。
On "the imperial carriage reached the capital city": Sun Ao's Critical Study of the Song History says it should read jingyi (the capital). Jingcheng would mean Jingkou." Note: Zizhi Tongjian reads Jiankang. In the Song History jingcheng usually means Jingkou; here the passage means Jiankang.
236
辛未車駕祠南郊各本並脫「辛未」二字，據南史、建康實錄、通鑑補。
On "xinwei, the imperial carriage sacrificed at the Southern Suburb": all editions drop xinwei; the date is restored from the Southern History, Veritable Record of Jiankang, and Comprehensive Mirror.
237
建安太守潘盛有罪伏誅「潘盛」各本作「潘城」，據少帝紀、徐羨之傳改。
On "Pan Sheng, Administrator of Jian'an, was guilty and executed": all editions read Pan Cheng for Pan Sheng; corrected per the Annals of the Deposed Emperor and the biography of Xu Xianzhi.
238
乙卯各本並作「己卯」，據局本及南史改。 按是月丁酉朔，十九日乙卯，無己卯。
On yimao: all editions read jimao; emended per the Bureau edition and Southern History. Note: that month began on dingyou; the nineteenth day was yimao—jimao is impossible.
239
領平北將軍南徐州刺史各本並脫「南」字，按彭城王義康傳、建康實錄、通鑑並作南徐州刺史，今據補。
On "Concurrent Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province": all editions omit South; the biography of Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Veritable Record of Jiankang, and Comprehensive Mirror agree on Southern Xu; restored accordingly.
240
以前征虜司馬尹沖為司州刺史各本並脫「尹」字，按索虜傳，時尹沖為司州刺史，通鑑同。 今據補。
On "former Campaigning-North Army Major Yin Chong made Inspector of Si Province": all editions omit Yin; the barbarian biography and Comprehensive Mirror place Yin Chong in that office; restored. The name is now restored.
241
征南大將軍檀道濟破索虜於東平壽張各本並脫「平」字。 據檀道濟傳補。 洪頤煊諸史考異云：「按檀道濟傳作東平壽張，此『東』下脫『平』字。」
On "Tan Daoji, Campaigning-South Grand General, defeated the Northern Barbarians at Dongping Shouzhang": all editions omit ping. Ping is supplied from the biography of Tan Daoji. Hong Yixuan, Variorum Notes on the Histories, writes: "Tan Daoji's biography has Dongping Shouzhang; ping has dropped after dong here."
242
苟不深存務本各本並脫「苟」字，據元龜一九八補。
On "if one does not deeply preserve the root of affairs": all editions omit gou; restored per Yuan Gui 198.
243
以吐谷渾慕容延為平東將軍「慕容延」本書吐谷渾傳作「慕延」。 魏書作「慕利延」。
On "Murong Yan of Tuyuhun made Pacifying-East General": this book's Tuyuhun biography reads Mu Yan for Murong Yan. The Wei History reads Mu Liyan.
244
吐谷渾輝伐為鎮軍將軍各本並脫「谷」字，據前後文例補。 「輝伐」魏書作「緯代」。
On "Huifa of Tuyuhun made General Who Stabilizes the Army": all editions omit gu in Tuyuhun; restored by context. Huifa in the Wei History appears as Weidai.
245
壬申河南國河西王遣使獻方物「河西王」各本作「西河王」，據少帝紀景平元年及大沮渠蒙遜傳改。
On "renshen, the King of the Western River of the Henan state sent envoys with tribute": all editions read West River for Western River; corrected per the Annals of the Deposed Emperor (Jingping 1) and the biography of Juqu Mengxun.
246
亡命馬大玄羣黨數百人寇泰山三朝本作「泰山」，弘治本、北監本、毛本、殿本、局本作「秦梁」。
On "the outlaw Ma Daxuan and several hundred followers raided Taishan": the Three Reigns edition has Taishan; Hongzhi, Northern Directorate, Mao, Hall, and Bureau editions read Qin and Liang.
247
夏四月乙酉按是月丁亥朔，無乙酉。 二十三日己酉，「乙酉」或是「己酉」之譌。
On "fourth month of summer, yiyou day": that month began on dinghai—yiyou cannot occur. The twenty-third day was jiyou; yiyou is likely a scribal error for jiyou.
248
秋七月辛酉「辛酉」各本並作「乙酉」，據南史改。 按是月庚戌朔，初六日辛酉，無「乙酉」。
On "seventh month of autumn, xinyou day": all editions read yiyou for xinyou; corrected per the Southern History. Note: that month began on gengxu; the sixth day was xinyou—yiyou is impossible.
249
於益州立南晉壽南新巴北巴西三郡各本並作「於益州立南晉壽新巴西三郡」。 孫虨宋書考論云：「據州郡志，是南晉壽、南新巴、北巴西三郡。 」按孫說是，今訂正。 又此條上云「壬申」，下云「乙亥」。 按是月丙戌朔，無壬申，亦無乙亥。
On "three commanderies established in Yi Province: Southern Jinshou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi": all editions read Southern Jinshou, Xinba, and Baxi only. Sun Ao's Critical Study of the Song History says: "Per the Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies, the three are Southern Jinshou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi. " Sun is right; the text is emended accordingly. This entry also has renshen above and yihai below. Note: that month began on bingxu—neither renshen nor yihai is possible.
250
以步兵校尉劉真道為梁南秦二州刺史「劉真道」各本並作「劉道真」。 張森楷校勘記云：「當作劉真道，見劉懷肅傳，下十八年亦作劉真道。 」按張說是，今改正。
On "Colonel of Footsoldiers Liu Zhendao made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin": all editions read Liu Daozhen for Liu Zhendao. Zhang Senkai's collation note says: "The name should be Liu Zhendao, as in the biography of Liu Huaisu; year eighteen below also has Liu Zhendao. " Zhang is correct; the reading is adopted.
251
河南國河西王訶羅單國並遣使獻方物「河西王」各本並作「西河王」，據少帝紀及大沮渠蒙遜傳改。
On "the King of the Western River of the Henan state and the Heluodan state both sent envoys with tribute": all editions read West River for Western River; corrected per the Annals of the Deposed Emperor and the biography of Juqu Mengxun.
252
燕王弘遣使獻方物「弘」各本並作「年」，據晉書載記改。
On "Yan king Hong sent envoys with tribute": all editions read Nian for Hong; corrected per the annals of the Jin History.
253
今年有不收處「年」各本並作「半」，據元龜四八九改。
On "this year there are places of failed harvest": all editions read half for year; corrected per Yuan Gui 489.
254
以光祿大夫王球為尚書僕射「王球」各本並作「王琳」，據南史、通鑑改。 洪頤煊諸史考異云：「王球作王琳，是傳寫之譌。」
On "Household Grandee Wang Qiu made Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat": all editions read Wang Lin for Wang Qiu; corrected per the Southern History and Comprehensive Mirror. Hong Yixuan, Variorum Notes on the Histories, says: "Writing Wang Qiu as Wang Lin is a copyist's mistake."
255
夏五月壬午「壬午」各本作「壬申」。 局本作「壬午」。 按是月壬午朔，無壬申。 今從局本。
On "fifth month of summer, renwu day": all editions read renshen for renwu. The Bureau edition has renwu. Note: that month began on renwu—renshen cannot occur. The Bureau reading is adopted.
256
尚書僕射王球卒「球」各本並作「琳」，據南史、通鑑改。
On "Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat Wang Qiu died": all editions read Lin for Qiu; corrected per the Southern History and Comprehensive Mirror.
257
是月各本並作十二月。 按上已有十月，十一月，十二月，不當重出十二月。 今改作是月。
On "that month": all editions read twelfth month. Note: the tenth, eleventh, and twelfth months already appear above—a second twelfth month is impossible. The text is changed to "that month."
258
盛王聖世「聖」各本並作「祖」，據元龜一九四改。
On "flourishing kings, sage age": all editions read ancestor for sage; corrected per Yuan Gui 194.
259
始奉礿祠「礿」各本並作「初」，據元龜二０七改。
On "first to offer the yue sacrifice": all editions read first for yue; corrected per Yuan Gui 207.
260
庚申各本同。 按是月壬申朔，初三日甲戌，是月無庚申。 下有甲申，為十三日。 甲戌、甲申之間有庚辰。 庚申疑庚辰之譌。
On gengshen: all editions agree. Note: that month began on renshen; the third day was jiaxu—gengshen cannot fall in this month. Jiashen follows below as the thirteenth day. Between jiaxu and jiashen stands gengchen. Gengshen is likely a scribal error for gengchen.
261
南徐南豫州揚州之浙江西各本同。 南史於「南徐」下有「南兗」二字。
On "Southern Xu, Southern Yu, and the west of the Zhe River in Yang Province": all editions agree. The Southern History inserts Southern Yan after Southern Xu.
262
南豫州刺史武陵王駿加撫軍將軍「駿」各本作「贊」，三朝本作「諱」。 按時武陵王駿，即後之孝武帝。 贊為宋明帝第九子，後亦封武陵王，時尚未生。 今改作「駿」。
On "Prince of Wuling Jun, Inspector of Southern Yu, additionally made General Who Pacifies the Army": all editions read Zan for Jun; the Three Reigns edition has taboo name. Note: Prince of Wuling Jun at this date was the future Emperor Xiaowu. Zan was Emperor Ming's ninth son and would later hold the same princely title; he was not yet born. The text is corrected to Jun.
263
征北將軍南徐州刺史南譙王義宣為車騎將軍荊州刺史「南徐州刺史」各本並脫「南」字，據義宣傳補。
On "Prince of Nanqiao Xuan, Campaigning-North General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province, made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jing Province": all editions omit South in Southern Xu; restored per Xuan's biography.
264
九月己未「己未」各本並作「乙未」，局本作「己未」。 按是月丁巳朔，初三日己未，無乙未。 今從局本。
On "ninth month, jiwei day": all editions read yimao for jiwei; the Bureau edition has jiwei. Note: that month began on dingsi; the third day was jiwei—yimao is impossible. The Bureau reading is adopted.
265
遷漢川流民於沔次「漢川」各本作「漢州」，按時無「漢州」，據元龜四八六改。
On "relocated Han River refugees to the banks of the Han": every edition reads Han Prefecture for Han River; no Han Prefecture existed at the time; emended per Yuan Gui 486.
266
三月丁巳下有乙丑。 各本同。 按是月丁卯朔，無丁巳，亦無乙丑。 四月丙申朔，二十二日丁巳，三十日乙丑。
On "third month, dingsi day": the text continues with yichou below. All received editions agree. Comment: that month began on dingmao; neither dingsi nor yichou could occur. In the fourth month the new moon was bingshen; the twenty-second day was dingsi and the thirtieth yichou.
267
辛亥各本並作「辛巳」。 通鑑考異云：「按長曆，二月壬辰朔，十日辛丑，二十日辛亥。 辛巳當作辛亥。 」今據改。
On "xinhai": all editions read xinsi. The Zizhi Tongjian Collation of Variants reads: "Per the Long Calendar, the second month's new moon was renchen; the tenth day was xinchou and the twentieth xinhai. Xinsi should be xinhai. " This emendation is adopted in the present text.
268
安北將軍徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號鎮軍將軍「駿」宋本作「諱」。 三朝本、北監本、毛本、殿本作「贊」，今據孝武帝紀訂正。 說見本卷校勘記第三十條。
On "Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces, Prince of Wuling Jun reduced to General Who Settles the Army": the Song edition has taboo name for Jun. The Three-Dynasties, Northern Supervisory, Mao, and Hall editions read Zan; the text is corrected per the Annals of Emperor Xiaowu. See collation note 30 in this juan.
269
五月乙酉亡命司馬順則自號齊王據梁鄒城丁巳婆皇國戊戌河南王並遣使獻方物按是年五月甲申朔，初二日乙酉，十五日戊戌，無丁巳。 丁巳日支當有誤。
On the fused entry "fifth month yiyou…dingsi…wuxu…presenting local products": that year the fifth month began on jiashen—the second day was yiyou and the fifteenth wuxu—so dingsi cannot stand. The dingsi date is corrupt.
270
居業未立「立」各本並作「能」，據元龜一九五改。
On "livelihoods not yet established": all editions read able for established; emended per Yuan Gui 195.
271
戊午各本並作「庚午」，據南史改。 按是月庚戌朔，無庚午。 初九日戊午。
On "wuwu": all editions read gengwu; corrected per the Nanshi. Comment: that month began on gengxu; gengwu did not occur. The correct date is the ninth day, wuwu.
